options.label: Follow him
options.detail: *Knowledge+, exposure risked.* Learn his habits — the streets, the callers, the letters. *(A watched man who knows he is watched stops being useful — but the habit might be learned first: the dusk, the post, the direction. Knowledge is the price; exposure is the risk.)*

options.label: Ask him directly
options.detail: *Nerve+, he deflects.* Confront the watch-chain man — at the next encounter, plainly. *(Villains sly, never overt: he will smile, deflect, and know he is suspected. The direct road warns him — but the warning itself is information: watch what he does with it.)*

options.label: Note and wait
options.detail: *Patience+, he ripens.* Record everything; do nothing; let him think himself unobserved. *(Patience risks losing him — but a man who believes he is unwatched grows careless, and carelessness is the patient hunter's harvest.)*

scenes.synopsis: The stranger, met by her chosen means — convergent texture; the cost, paid. (Turns: 8)
scenes.prose:
> *(The means, enacted — and the week gives her its answer.)*
> *(If she followed: Ned on the streets — the watch-chain man traced to his Strand lodgings, his habits mapped: the calls, the club, the letters posted at dusk. If she asked: the park, the pleasantries, then plainly — "You ask a great deal about Hartwell, sir." — the smile, the varnish-smooth deflection, banked. If she waited: the pocketbook filling — the pattern, ripening.)*
> (T1 · look closer) *She examines what the means returned — the habits mapped, the deflection measured, the pattern ripened.* — remembered: *the return, itemized.*
> *(The cost, whichever road: following risked Ned's exposure; asking warned him; waiting cost time — a week of his circling softer targets.)*
> (T2 · stance) *She prices what the road cost — the exposure risked, the warning given, the time spent.* — remembered: *the cost, paid.*
> *(And the convergent truth, underneath all three: he is still the watch-chain man. Unnamed. Unplaced. But no longer unmeasured. The means differed. The knowledge converges.)*
> (T3 · look closer) *She measures him now — the dusk postings, the smooth deflection, the Strand lodgings; unnamed, unplaced, but measured.* — remembered: *the measure, taken.*
> "A friend of the family," Rose repeats to the empty room, trying the phrase the way one tries a lock. "One takes an interest."
> (T4 · tone) *She tries his phrase — dryly, turning it; or coldly, filing it; or with a short laugh, at the varnish of it.* — remembered: *the phrase, tried.*
> *(She writes it in the pocketbook — "A friend of the family. One takes an interest." — underlining "interest" twice, under Augusta's maxim: find who pays him. The interest is paid for. By whom?)*
> (T5 · remembered micro-decision) *She files his phrase under the maxim — the interest, paid for; the payer, still unknown.* — remembered: *the phrase, filed.*
> (T6 · social maneuver) *She decides the stranger's next move is his to make — she has met the circle; now she watches where it bends.* — remembered: *the circle, watched.*
> *(Cecilia's note, breathless: he has not called again. Rose reads the pause as she read the deflection — a man met, deciding his next approach.)*
> (T7 · dialogue) *She answers Cecilia's note — "Well poured. Keep pouring." — the post, confirmed.* — remembered: *the post, held.*
> (T8 · stance) *She banks the week — the stranger measured, the cost paid, the circle watched; the hunt's second front, mapped.* — remembered: *the front, mapped.*

scenes.synopsis: The trap's first report — the decoy copied in the ordinary course; Thursday's post gone; the lie, traveling. (Turns: 8)
scenes.prose:
> *(Quill's note — four lines, the solicitor's hand: COPIED THURSDAY. IN THE ORDINARY COURSE. THE POST IS GONE. WE WATCH THE WORLD NOW.)*
> (T1 · look closer) *She reads the four lines — the ordinary course, the gone post; the trap's first milestone.* — remembered: *the milestone, read.*
> *(She pictures it — Thursday: Alder's hands on the decoy, the quill moving, Schedule 9 copied among the true schedules like a wolf among sheep. The lie is traveling.)*
> (T2 · look closer) *She pictures the copying — the quill, the wolf among sheep.* — remembered: *the lie, imagined traveling.*
> *(Quill calls that afternoon — the settlements' pretext, genuine as ever — and they sit in the inner office with the window onto the outer office.)*
> "We watch the world now," Quill says. "The letter, the paragraph, the rumor — Schedule 9 will surface in one of them, if it surfaces. A schedule that does not exist cannot stay hidden. It has nowhere to hide except in plain sight."
> (T3 · dialogue) *She asks — "How long?" — or states: "A week. Perhaps two." — the waiting, repriced.* — remembered: *the waiting, repriced.*
> "A week. Perhaps two." — Quill
> (T4 · stance) *She accepts the repricing — the patient hunter, again; the trap is a season, not a blow.* — remembered: *the season, accepted.*
> *(She looks through the window — the copying room, the too-neat desk, Alder at it, the quill moving in its neat relentless hand. The pigeonhole — the second from the left — she cannot see from here. She imagines it full now, or empty still.)*
> (T5 · look closer) *She studies Alder through the window — the quill, the neatness, the unlooking; the lie, already beyond him.* — remembered: *the beyond, noted.*
> (T6 · social maneuver) *She decides what to watch while the world answers — the Gazette, the routs, the rumors.* — remembered: *the stages, set.*
> *(Quill walks her to the door — the outer office, the clerks, the half-open door to the copying room — and says, very low: "Miss Hartwell. Whatever surfaces — you laid this well." She carries it home like a sealed letter.)*
> (T7 · tone) *She takes the praise — gravely; or with the small smile of the professional, acknowledged.* — remembered: *the praise, carried home.*
> (T8 · remembered micro-decision) *She writes in the pocketbook, under SCHEDULE 9: "Traveling. The world must answer." — the trap's second milestone.* — remembered: *the milestone, entered.*

scenes.synopsis: The refusal's consequence — convergent texture; what her chosen means returned. (Turns: 8)
scenes.prose:
> *(The week after the decision — and the means return their harvest.)*
> *(If she accepted: the compact kept — Julian easier, the money unmentioned; a hothouse cutting, unasked, saying what money could not. If she insisted: the strain — a week of careful ease — then the repair: she asks his advice on the drainage, and the needing mends the pressing. If she investigated: the architecture learned — the debts, the owing, delicately asked and answered; the knowing deepens everything.)*
> (T1 · look closer) *She examines the harvest — the hothouse cutting, the mended ease, the architecture learned.* — remembered: *the harvest, gathered.*
> *(The convergent truth: the refusal stands. He has not taken the money — will not take it, in any of the three weeks. But the trust — the trust is the outcome. The means differed. The trust converges.)*
> (T2 · stance) *She banks the convergence — the refusal stands; the trust is the outcome; the signature was hers.* — remembered: *the convergence, banked.*
> *(They walk — the garden, the ordinary hour — and he tells her of his plans: the work he has taken, the debts he will pay, the years priced. She listens, and does not offer, and the not-offering is the trust made audible.)*
> (T3 · dialogue) *She listens — the friend, not the benefactor.* — remembered: *the listening, the trust made audible.*
> "You are very quiet about the trap," Julian says. "The clerk. The lie."
> "The trap works without me," Rose says. "I am practicing husbandry."
> (T4 · tone) *She says it — lightly, the new doctrine worn easily; or wryly: "The thrush approves."* — remembered: *the doctrine, worn.*
> *(He laughs — the first easy laugh she has heard from him in weeks — and she understands that the refusal, honored whatever the means, has given him back something the money would have taken: the ease of a man who is not obligated.)*
> (T5 · look closer) *She studies the laugh — easy, unguarded.* — remembered: *the laugh, the restoration.*
> (T6 · remembered micro-decision) *She files the laugh under HOPE — the heading, accruing interest.* — remembered: *the interest, accrued.*
> *(They part at the garden gate — the ordinary farewell — and she watches him go with the pocketbook's lesson underlining itself: the trust is not the money. It never was.)*
> (T7 · stance) *She watches him go — the friend, free.* — remembered: *the lesson, underlined.*
> (T8 · tone) *She carries the week home — tenderly.* — remembered: *the week, carried.*

scenes.synopsis: Two fronts — the hunt's texture at the waiting's height; the clerk and the stranger, the lie and the circle. (Turns: 7)
scenes.prose:
> *(The waiting's height. Two fronts, one hunter.)*
> *(Front the first: the copying room. Schedule 9 traveling — in a letter, in a paragraph, in a rumor; the world, being watched for a schedule that does not exist. Quill watches the office. She watches the world.)*
> (T1 · look closer) *She surveys the first front — the office watched, the world watched; the lie, somewhere abroad.* — remembered: *the front, surveyed.*
> *(Front the second: the watch-chain man. Measured — the dusk postings, the deflection, the Strand lodgings — but unnamed, unplaced. Cecilia pouring instead of answering. The circle, watched for where it bends.)*
> (T2 · look closer) *She surveys the second front — the measure taken, the name withheld; the circle, watched.* — remembered: *the front, surveyed.*
> *(And Augusta's maxim over both, like a standard: find who pays him, and you find who owned Rackham. The clerk's paymaster. The stranger's interest, paid for. Two hands, perhaps one purse.)*
> (T3 · stance) *She holds the maxim over both fronts — two hands, perhaps one purse; the paymaster, the quarry.* — remembered: *the maxim, held.*
> *(She is — she realizes, sitting with the pocketbook in the afternoon light — content. Not happy; the waiting forbids happy. But content: the trap laid, the trust filed, the stranger measured, the maxim entered. The hunt is husbandry, and the husbandry is sound.)*
> (T4 · tone) *She names the state — content, not happy; the husbandry, sound.* — remembered: *the state, named.*
> *(She thinks of the chapel — the five-word note, the empty chapel — and how far the hunt has traveled since: from a warning to a copying room, from a copying room to the world, from the world toward a paymaster's purse. The countries change. The husbandry does not.)*
> (T5 · remembered micro-decision) *She writes, under HOPE: "The husbandry is sound." — the doctrine, evidenced.* — remembered: *the evidence, filed.*
> *(Letitia looks in — the embroidery, the pocketbook — and says: "You look like a general, my love." "I am practicing," Rose says, "to be a patient one.")*
> (T6 · dialogue) *She answers Letitia — "A patient general." — the doctrine, declared.* — remembered: *the declaration, made.*
> (T7 · stance) *She sits with the two fronts — the waiting, the watching; the hunter, husbanding.* — remembered: *the husbandry, continued.*

scenes.synopsis: The dusk watch, planned — Alder's posting habit; where to stand, when, and who stands with her. (Turns: 8)
scenes.prose:
> *(Quill's intelligence — the week's quiet accumulation: Alder leaves the office at dusk. Every evening, at dusk, with the day's post — the office post, and, some evenings, a letter that is not office business. Posted separately. Posted carefully. The habit, learned.)*
> (T1 · look closer) *She examines the intelligence — the dusk, the separate posting, the care; the habit, learned.* — remembered: *the habit, learned.*
> *(The plan forms — the way the Thursday visit formed: on paper, in her clearest hand. The office closes at dusk. The post office is in the next street. Between the two: a stretch of pavement, a bookseller's doorway, a vantage. She will stand where the dusk gathers thickest, and watch.)*
> (T2 · social maneuver) *She plans the watch — the pavement, the bookseller's doorway, the dusk; the vantage, chosen.* — remembered: *the vantage, chosen.*
> *(Who stands with her? Not Quill — the solicitor cannot be seen watching his own clerk; the office's ruin, priced. Not Letitia — the aunt's presence would be remarked. Ned — the river-man, discreet as water — or alone? The hunter's question.)*
> (T3 · choice — the company:) *She decides — Ned, discreet as water; or alone, the hunter solitary.*
> - **Ned** — *Cover+.* The river-man, unmarked; two watchers, each the other's alibi.
> - **Alone** — *Nerve+.* The hunter solitary; no witness, no risk but her own.
> (T4 · stance) *She settles the question — the company, chosen; the watch, staffed.* — remembered: *the watch, staffed.*
> *(The evening for it: tomorrow. The week's rhythm — Friday's post gone, the weekend's quiet — no; the dusk habit is daily, Quill says. Tomorrow, then. At dusk. The bookseller's doorway.)*
> (T5 · remembered micro-decision) *She fixes the evening — tomorrow, at dusk; the plan, dated.* — remembered: *the date, fixed.*
> *(She tells no one — not Letitia, not Quill, not the pocketbook yet. Some plans are safer unfiled until they are done. She lays out the plainest pelisse, the darkest bonnet — the severe felt, perhaps; dusk requires severity — and practices standing still.)*
> (T6 · remembered micro-decision) *She lays out the dusk dress — the plainest pelisse, the darkest bonnet; the watcher, costumed.* — remembered: *the costume, laid.*
> (T7 · tone) *She practices the stillness — the bookseller's doorway, the gathering dusk; the hunter, rehearsed.* — remembered: *the rehearsal, done.*
> (T8 · stance) *She banks the plan — tomorrow, at dusk; Alder, the letter, the vantage; the chapter's end, approaching.* — remembered: *the approach, banked.*

scenes.synopsis: The copying book — Quill's full report; the decoy's ordinary passage; what the office shows. (Turns: 8)
scenes.prose:
> *(Quill's chambers — the pretext, the settlements, wearing thin but holding — and the copying book open between them, the office's own record. Quill turns the pages to Thursday.)*
> "There." His finger rests on the entry — the false codicil reference, in the ordinary hand, in the ordinary place. "Entered Thursday. Copied Thursday afternoon — Alder's hand, the copying book attests it. It went with Thursday's post."
> (T1 · look closer) *She studies the entry — the ordinary hand, the ordinary place; the lie.* — remembered: *the entry, witnessed.*
> *(The decoy passed through his hands in the ordinary course of business, as bread passes through a kitchen. The trap's machinery has turned once, cleanly.)*
> (T2 · stance) *She banks the attestation — the hand, the course, the passage.* — remembered: *the turning, banked.*
> "And the office?" — Rose. "Does it show anything?"
> "The office shows a clerk at his desk," Quill says. "Diligent. Quiet. The neatest desk in Lincoln's Inn." A pause. "Miss Hartwell — if your Schedule 9 does not surface, I will have built a trap for an innocent man, and I will have to live with the building of it."
> (T3 · dialogue) *She answers — "It will surface." — the certainty, lent; or "Then we will have learned he is innocent." — the honesty, kept.* — remembered: *the answer, given.*
> *(She looks through the window — the copying room, the too-neat desk, Alder at it, the quill moving. The pigeonhole, in this light, looks full. Or empty.)*
> (T4 · look closer) *She studies the desk through the window — the quill, the neatness; the pigeonhole, unreadable at this distance.* — remembered: *the distance, accepted.*
> (T5 · social maneuver) *She decides what the week wants of her — the Gazette watched, the routs watched, the rumors weighed.* — remembered: *the stages, manned.*
> *(Quill closes the copying book — the record, shut — and says what solicitors say when the law has done all it can: "We wait, Miss Hartwell.")*
> (T6 · tone) *She takes the waiting — wryly: "I am becoming extremely good at it."; or gravely: "We wait."* — remembered: *the skill, unwanted but owned.*
> (T7 · remembered micro-decision) *She writes in the pocketbook, under SCHEDULE 9: "Copied Thursday. Alder's hand. The post is gone." — the third milestone.* — remembered: *the milestone, entered.*
> (T8 · stance) *She leaves the chambers — the world's answer, pending.* — remembered: *the pending, carried.*

scenes.synopsis: Watching the world — the Gazette, the routs, the rumors; Schedule 9's three stages. (Turns: 8)
scenes.prose:
> *(The world's three stages, and Rose on all of them.)*
> *(The Gazette — read over chocolate, every morning, Bell's dry verdicts scanned for a schedule that does not exist. If Schedule 9 surfaces in print, it surfaces here first.)*
> (T1 · look closer) *She scans the Gazette — the nonexistent schedule, sought in print.* — remembered: *the scanning, daily.*
> *(The routs — the season's machinery, the ton unguarded after midnight. She goes, she dances, she listens. A schedule number dropped in gossip would travel the ballrooms faster than any post. Letitia's ear, Cecilia's pouring, her own — the listening, distributed.)*
> (T2 · social maneuver) *She works the routs — the listening, distributed.* — remembered: *the listening, distributed.*
> *(The rumors — the city's other post. Ned on the river, the servants' hall, Élise's fitting rooms where all of London undresses and talks. A rumor of a Schedule 9 would surface in the fitting rooms before anywhere — women tell their modistes what they tell no one.)*
> (T3 · social maneuver) *She tasks the rumor-road — the city's other post, manned.* — remembered: *the road, manned.*
> *(And nothing. Days pass — the Gazette dry and scheduleless, the routs full of other gossip, the fitting rooms full of other secrets. Schedule 9 does not surface. The lie travels, or it does not.)*
> (T4 · stance) *She holds the nothing — the patience, the discipline; the trap is a season.* — remembered: *the nothing, held.*
> *(She considers the possibility Quill raised — the innocent man, the built trap — and examines it honestly, the way she examined the blotter's pale corner. The fresh sand. The empty pigeonhole. The varnish-smooth deference. No. The desk was performing. She trusts the examination.)*
> (T5 · look closer) *She re-examines the evidence — the examination, trusted.* — remembered: *the trust, kept.*
> (T6 · tone) *She steadies herself — the hunter's discipline; certainty is not proof, but it is not nothing.* — remembered: *the steadiness, held.*
> *(She writes in the pocketbook, under SCHEDULE 9: "Sought in print, in ballrooms, in fitting rooms. Not yet surfaced." — and under it, Augusta's maxim, again, like a standard: find who pays him.)*
> (T7 · remembered micro-decision) *She enters the negative result — the seeking, evidenced; the maxim, restated.* — remembered: *the negative, evidenced.*
> (T8 · stance) *She keeps the three stages manned — the waiting, the watching.* — remembered: *the watch, kept.*

scenes.synopsis: The stranger, quiet — Cecilia's report: he has not called again; the circling pauses. (Turns: 7)
scenes.prose:
> *(Cecilia's note — breathless, as ever: he has not called again. Not at the rout. Not in the park. The morning call stands alone, unrepeated. The circling pauses.)*
> (T1 · look closer) *She reads the pause — the unrepeated call; the circling, stilled.* — remembered: *the stillness, read.*
> *(Rose reads the stillness the way she read the deflection: a man who has been met, deciding his next approach. The asking warned him — or the following was noticed — or the waiting simply outlasted his patience. Whichever means she chose, the pause is its echo.)*
> (T2 · stance) *She interprets the echo — met, and deciding; the means, reverberating.* — remembered: *the echo, interpreted.*
> *(She calls on Cecilia — the girl subdued, the thrill of the hunt's other watcher faded into something quieter. Rose is glad of the quieter. Thrill gets watchers noticed.)*
> "You did well," Rose says. "The pouring. The reporting. Now we do the hardest thing."
> "Which is?"
> "Nothing. We go on pouring nothing, and we wait to see where he pours next."
> (T3 · dialogue) *She instructs — "Nothing, beautifully poured." — the post, continued.* — remembered: *the instruction, given.*
> (T4 · tone) *She steadies the girl — warmly; the subdued watcher, kept subdued.* — remembered: *the steadiness, lent.*
> *(Cecilia nods — and then, with the abruptness of the young: "Rose. Why me? Why does he ask me about Hartwell?" And Rose, who has been asking herself the same question, gives the honest answer: "Because you were my dearest friend, and the ton believes you still know everything. It is the only value he thinks you have left.")*
> (T5 · look closer) *She watches the answer land — the girl, valued only for her proximity; the cruelty of it, the truth of it.* — remembered: *the landing, watched.*
> *(It lands hard. Cecilia looks away — and Rose, seeing the girl's face, understands something she will remember in Bath, much later: a girl who is valued only for what she knows about Rose is a girl the Network will eventually buy. The pause now is not safety. It is the market, deciding its price.)*
> (T6 · look closer) *She foresees it — the market, deciding; the girl, buyable; the pause, not safety.* — remembered: *the foresight, filed.*
> (T7 · remembered micro-decision) *She writes under the watch-chain sketch: "Quiet. The market decides." — the warning, entered.* — remembered: *the warning, entered.*

scenes.synopsis: The compact, kept — Julian's ordinary friendship; the trust, accruing. (Turns: 7)
scenes.prose:
> *(The compact, kept — and the ordinary friendship, accruing interest.)*
> *(Julian calls — the morning call, the civility — and there is no money between them now, not even unmentioned. The refusal, honored by whatever means she chose, has cleared the weather. He talks of his work — the honest work, the debts priced in years — and she talks of the estate — the drainage, the tenants — and the conversation is the thing itself, needing no transaction.)*
> (T1 · look closer) *She studies the cleared weather — the work, the estate, the conversation; the thing itself.* — remembered: *the weather, cleared.*
> *(He asks after the trap — the clerk, the lie — and she tells him what can be told: the decoy copied, the post gone, the world being watched. He listens the way he listened in the chapel's shadow — the ally, not the audience.)*
> (T2 · dialogue) *She tells him — the decoy, the post, the watching; the ally, trusted with the hunt.* — remembered: *the telling, trusted.*
> "And the stranger?" — Julian. "The watch-chain man."
> "Quiet. Measuring his next approach, or abandoning this one." She hesitates. "Augusta says: find who pays him, and you find who owned Rackham."
> (T3 · dialogue) *She shares the maxim — the paymaster, the quarry; the hunt's true north, spoken aloud.* — remembered: *the maxim, shared.*
> *(He turns it over — the brother's debts have taught him about paymasters — and nods slowly. "Then the clerk is the least of it." "The clerk," Rose agrees, "is the evidence. Not the quarry.")*
> (T4 · stance) *They hold the re-aiming together — the evidence, not the quarry; the hunt, shared.* — remembered: *the sharing, held.*
> *(He leaves her with a book — lent, not given; the distinction, observed with a smile — and she understands that the compact has become something sturdier than either the money or the refusal: a friendship that has priced itself and paid in full.)*
> (T5 · remembered micro-decision) *She takes the lent book — the distinction, observed; the friendship, priced and paid.* — remembered: *the book, borrowed.*
> (T6 · tone) *She sees him out — warmly; the ordinary farewell, the accruing trust.* — remembered: *the farewell, warm.*
> (T7 · stance) *She files the week under HOPE — the compact kept, the friendship sturdier; the interest, compounding.* — remembered: *the compounding, filed.*

scenes.synopsis: Bell's verdict — the chapel hours, noticed. (Turns: 1 — the reading)
scenes.prose:
> *(The morning Gazette, read over chocolate. Mrs. Nance Bell, proprietor, in her own dry voice:)*
> *"The Hartwell solicitor keeps chapel hours. The law, one hears, has its devotions."*
> (T1 · stance) *Rose reads it twice — the amusement first (devotions!), then the wariness: how does Bell know about the chapel? The paper sees everything; the paper judges, and narrates, and never explains its seeing. She files the sting under its lesson: in London, even chapels have an audience.* — remembered: *the lesson: even chapels have an audience.*
scenes.sting: The Hartwell solicitor keeps chapel hours. The law, one hears, has its devotions.

scenes.synopsis: The war council reconvenes — two fronts, one maxim; Letitia's read of the waiting. (Turns: 8)
scenes.prose:
> *(The war council reconvenes — Letitia's sitting room, the embroidery, the campaign map revised. Rose reports both fronts.)*
> (T1 · look closer) *She lays out the map — the two fronts, the maxim over both.* — remembered: *the map, laid.*
> "Nothing has surfaced," Letitia says. "And the stranger has gone quiet. My dear, I have lived a long life, and I tell you plainly: in my experience, when the hunt goes quiet, it is the hunter who should make the noise — or the hunted, preparing to."
> (T2 · dialogue) *She takes the axiom — the quiet, priced; the noise, considered.* — remembered: *the axiom, taken.*
> *(Rose tells her Augusta's maxim — find who pays him, and you find who owned Rackham — and Letitia is silent a long moment, the commander revising the campaign's objective.)*
> "Your grandmother," Letitia says at last, "has always seen the money first and the men afterward. It is a gift. It is also — " dryly — "why no one ever surprised her, and why she was never, in her whole life, surprised to be right."
> (T3 · tone) *She receives the portrait — wryly; Augusta, seen.* — remembered: *the portrait, received.*
> (T4 · stance) *She adopts the re-aiming formally — the council's new objective: not the clerk, not the stranger, but the paymaster behind both.* — remembered: *the objective, adopted.*
> *(They plan the noise — or the quiet. Letitia's counsel: the dusk watch, planned for this week — let the hunter see the posting with her own eyes. "A trap is arithmetic," Letitia says. "But an eye is a witness. Be the witness, my love.")*
> (T5 · social maneuver) *She takes the counsel — the dusk watch, confirmed.* — remembered: *the counsel, taken.*
> "And if the letter is innocent?" — Rose. "If Alder posts nothing but office business, and I have watched a clerk be diligent at dusk?"
> "Then," Letitia says, "you will have spent an evening being wrong in a bookseller's doorway, which is among the cheaper tuitions this hunt affords. Go and be wrong, my love. It is the only way to be right."
> (T6 · dialogue) *She takes the tuition — the cheap wrongness, the only road to right.* — remembered: *the tuition, accepted.*
> (T7 · remembered micro-decision) *She writes in the pocketbook: "Be the witness." — Letitia's counsel, entered.* — remembered: *the counsel, entered.*
> (T8 · stance) *She rises — the council adjourned; the dusk, approaching.* — remembered: *the approach, noted.*

scenes.synopsis: The stranger, sighted — the circling resumes, elsewhere; the market has decided. (Turns: 7)
scenes.prose:
> *(The park — the afternoon promenade, the ton on parade — and there: the watch-chain, glinting at the far end of the Row. The stranger. Not circling Cecilia now — circling wider: a banker's wife, a young officer, a modiste's girl with a pattern book. The market has decided, and the market is shopping.)*
> (T1 · look closer) *She sights him — the watch-chain, the wider circle; the market, shopping.* — remembered: *the sighting, noted.*
> *(She watches from the carriage — the lowered eyes, the angle of inattention, the old cover — and notes the method: pleasantries, the turn to business, the questions. Always the questions. The settlements. The Park. Who holds what, who owes whom. Inventory, practiced on softer targets.)*
> (T2 · look closer) *She studies the method — the pleasantries, the turn, the questions; inventory, practiced.* — remembered: *the method, studied.*
> *(He does not approach her. He does not approach Cecilia — who is not here today, kept home by Rose's instruction, pouring nothing beautifully. He works the softer targets, and the softness of them troubles her more than any direct approach would.)*
> (T3 · stance) *She notes the avoidance — not her, not Cecilia; the softer targets, chosen.* — remembered: *the avoidance, noted.*
> *(Augusta's maxim, again: find who pays him. The interest is paid for — the morning calls, the club, the Strand lodgings, the patient circling. Someone funds the inventory. Someone wants the Park priced. The paymaster, behind the watch-chain.)*
> (T4 · look closer) *She follows the money upward — the lodgings, the circling, the patience; the paymaster, behind the chain.* — remembered: *the upward, followed.*
> *(She lets the carriage carry her past — no confrontation, no sign; the means she chose, honored — and writes in the pocketbook, under the watch-chain sketch: "Sighted on the Row. Working softer targets. The market decided: he is buying.")*
> (T5 · remembered micro-decision) *She enters the sighting — the Row, the targets; the buying, evidenced.* — remembered: *the buying, evidenced.*
> (T6 · tone) *She carries it home — grimly; the inventory, the paymaster, the Park priced.* — remembered: *the grimness, carried.*
> (T7 · stance) *She banks the sighting — the second front, active; the dusk watch, tonight.* — remembered: *the banking, done.*

scenes.synopsis: The dusk habit, confirmed — Quill's last intelligence; the posting, the care, the separate letter. (Turns: 8)
scenes.prose:
> *(Quill's note — by hand, the same day: AT DUSK. DAILY. THE OFFICE POST, AND SOMETIMES A LETTER BESIDE IT. POSTED SEPARATELY. POSTED WITH CARE.)*

scenes.synopsis: The chapter's seal — Alder, at dusk, posting a letter that is not office business. (Turns: 7)
scenes.prose:
> *(The receiving house. The late post. Alder steps to the slot — and the letter, the separate letter, the letter held apart all the way from Lincoln's Inn — goes in. Posted separately. Posted with care. Never in the post-book.)*
> (T1 · look closer) *She watches the posting — the slot, the letter, the care; the separate, made final.* — remembered: *the posting, witnessed.*
> *(He stands a moment — the thin figure in the dusk, the hand empty now — and looks up and down the street. Not hurried. Not guilty. The look of a man completing a routine. Then he turns toward home, and is gone into the gathering dark.)*
> (T2 · look closer) *She studies the after — the empty hand, the routine look; the innocence, performed or true.* — remembered: *the after, studied.*
> *(She does not follow him home. The witness has seen what the witness came to see. She steps back into the bookseller's shadow — Ned a nod across the street, the alibi complete — and lets the dusk close over the street like a ledger closing.)*
> (T3 · stance) *She stands down — the witness, complete; the alibi, nodded.* — remembered: *the standing-down, done.*
> *(The letter is in the post. The lie — Schedule 9, traveling — may or may not be in it. The stranger's interest — paid for, by whom — may or may not have paid for it. Augusta's maxim over all of it, like a standard: find who pays him, and you find who owned Rackham.)*
> (T4 · look closer) *She weighs the unknowns — the lie, the interest, the payer; the maxim, over all.* — remembered: *the weighing, done.*
> *(She walks home through the dusk — the severe felt, the plain pelisse, the pocketbook in her reticule with its four headings: ALDER, SCHEDULE 9, JULIAN, HOPE — and understands, with the cold clarity that has been building all chapter, that the trap has done its work and the hunt has only begun.)*

> (T7 · tone) *She closes the pocketbook — the chapter, sealed; the dusk, kept.* — remembered: *the seal, set.*
> *(The lamp is turned down. The chapter seals. And Rose Hartwell — who began with a solicitor's summons to a chapel — ends it with the image she will carry into the next chapter: Alder, at dusk, posting a letter that is not office business.)*

> (T2 · look closer) *She reads Henderson's note — the hour, the direction; the trap's first fruit, delivered overnight.* — remembered: *the fruit, received.*
> "The false document," Quill says — the memorandum, the lie neat and legal — "was left where the copying book demanded it be copied. On top of the Hartwell file. Where Alder must copy it." He looks at her. "However you chose to hunt him, Miss Hartwell — boldly, patiently, cunningly — the road led here."
> (T3 · stance) *She takes the convergence — the three roads, one destination; the hunting, honored in its means.* — remembered: *the convergence, taken.*
> *(She thinks of the decision — confront, follow, or trap — and understands: the means differed, but the destination was fixed. The trap does not care how it was laid. It cares that it holds.)*

> "And did he copy it?" — Rose.
> "The copying book shows the entry — in his hand, neat as ever." Quill's smile is thin. "And Henderson saw the copy made. The lie, Miss Hartwell, has been faithfully reproduced. In Alder's perfect hand. It only wants — " he taps the note — "to walk. Which, last evening at six o'clock, it did."

scenes.synopsis: The lie's journey — Long Lane; the proof ripening; Monday's bite. (Turns: 8)
scenes.prose:
> *(Long Lane — the City posting-house, barely respectable, the kind that asks no questions for a fee. Quill has done the solicitor's homework: the dusk letter went there, the false copy went there, and from there — the books show nothing. Barely respectable means barely recorded. The lie has walked into a fog.)*
> (T1 · look closer) *She studies the fog — the unrecorded, the unfranked; the lie, abroad without a trail.* — remembered: *the fog, studied.*
> "Then how do we prove it walked?" — Rose.
> "We wait." — Quill, and the word costs him visibly. "The lie is bait, Miss Hartwell. Bait is not proved by watching it walk. Bait is proved — " he leans forward — "by what bites it."
> (T2 · dialogue) *She takes the doctrine — the bait, the bite; the solicitor's patience, borrowed.* — remembered: *the doctrine, taken.*
> *(The weekend passes — the Gazette, the routs, the ordinary machinery — and Rose watches the world the way she watched the copying room: for a schedule that does not exist, surfacing where it should not.)*
> (T3 · stance) *She keeps the watch — the print, the ballrooms; the nonexistent, sought.* — remembered: *the watch, kept.*
> *(Monday. The bite. It comes sideways, through routine: a stranger calls at Quill's chambers, asking after "the Hartwell supplementary schedule of instruments" — and quotes them. The three instruments. The dates. The witnesses. The false schedule — the lie, neat and legal — quoted back to Quill's face by a man who should never have seen it.)*
> (T4 · look closer) *She fixes the bite — the quotation, word for word; the lie, believed and acted upon.* — remembered: *the bite, fixed.*
> *(Quill tells it standing — too agitated to sit, the professional mask in ruins. "He had it from the copy. From Alder's copy. The lie walked to Long Lane, and Long Lane carried it, and now it has come back — " he stops — "wearing the wrong hands.")*
> (T5 · tone) *She steadies him — the solicitor's ruin, witnessed; the proof, complete.* — remembered: *the steadiness, lent.*
> *(She is very still. The trap, closed. The proof, complete — not the watching, not the posting, but the quotation: the lie, believed, acted upon, quoted back. The first ripple, lapping at Quill's door.)*
> (T6 · stance) *She names the closure — the trap shut, the proof complete; the ripple, arrived.* — remembered: *the closure, named.*
> "Then we confront him." — Rose.
> "Then," Quill says quietly, "we confront him."
> (T7 · dialogue) *She speaks the decision — the confrontation, declared; the breaking, scheduled.* — remembered: *the declaration, made.*
> (T8 · remembered micro-decision) *She writes under ALDER: "Quoted back. Word for word." — the proof, entered.* — remembered: *the proof, entered.*

scenes.synopsis: Planning the confrontation — Quill's terms; Wednesday; the quiet-authority brief. (Turns: 8)
scenes.prose:
> *(Tuesday. Rose plans the confrontation the way she planned the watching — on paper, in her clearest hand, facts first. Quill's terms, laid down Monday evening: the confrontation happens in his office, in the inner office, with the door closed. Alder is summoned — not accused, summoned; the difference, Quill says, is the difference between proof and slander. The evidence is laid out: the copying-book entry, Henderson's note, the stranger's quotation. Then — and only then — the question.)*
> (T1 · look closer) *She lays out the terms — the summons, the evidence, the question; the solicitor's precision, adopted.* — remembered: *the terms, laid.*
> *(The timing: Wednesday afternoon. Alder will be there, at the too-neat desk, unsuspecting. The summons comes mid-afternoon — "Mr. Quill wishes to see you" — the ordinary words, the ordinary terror.)*
> (T2 · stance) *She fixes the timing — Wednesday; the ordinary terror, scheduled.* — remembered: *the schedule, fixed.*
> *(The cover: none needed. This is not watching — this is breaking. Rose will be there — Quill insists, the client whose paper was stolen. Not bored now. Not dismissed. Present — the way a creditor is present.)*
> (T3 · stance) *She takes her place in the plan — the creditor, present; the dismissal, reversed.* — remembered: *the place, taken.*
> *(She examines the plan for holes — the solicitor's habit: what if Alder denies? The quotation denies denial. What if he runs? Henderson watches the passage door. What if he weeps? She considers this — the thin young man, the wet-paper eyes — and sets it aside. Weeping is not a hole in the plan. Weeping is the plan working.)*
> (T4 · look closer) *She probes for holes — denial, flight, tears; the plan, sound.* — remembered: *the soundness, probed.*
> *(She writes at the bottom: WHAT DOES HE KNOW? And under it: WHO PAYS HIM? The two questions, the hunt's whole doctrine.)*

> *(Then the second page — the preparation. Not boredom now. Authority. Letitia, consulted, nods slowly — the quartermaster again — and says the word that becomes the ritual's brief: "Quiet. Not loud, my love. Loud is fear. Quiet — " the smile — "quiet is the thing clerks cannot answer.")*

> (T7 · tone) *She steadies herself — the breaking, faced; the gravity, worn early.* — remembered: *the gravity, worn.*

scenes.synopsis: ★ DRESSING RITUAL — a solicitor's office visit; the brief is quiet authority: business dress for a woman who is not here to be dismissed, but to dismiss. (Turns: 21 — direction + 20 pins)
scenes.prose:
> *(System: the occasion brief is published.)*
> **Occasion brief — The Confrontation at Lincoln's Inn.** *Quill's inner office, Wednesday afternoon. The brief is quiet authority. Editorial criterion — every choice is judged on whether it says* I know *without saying it so loudly that it becomes* I accuse. *Loud is fear; quiet is the thing clerks cannot answer. Authority, worn the way a seal is worn: plain, heavy, final.*
> *(Three directions on the stand:)*
> **A. The Iron Grey** — charcoal merino, severe lines; authority as armor. Motif: Greek-key border in steel-grey at the hem, exact as a ledger ruling. Thread: **steel** / **silver** / **black silk**. Accessories: dark kid gloves; small steel studs; no necklace — the throat closed; a severe dark hairpin; structured dark reticule.
> **B. The Velvet Gavel** — deep claret velvet, soft but absolute; authority as certainty. Motif: oak-leaves at cuffs and throat, worked small. Thread: **gold** / **copper** / **polychrome** (deep jewel petals — ruby, garnet, amber). Accessories: claret kid gloves; small garnet drops; a slim gold chain, barely there; a velvet bow, restrained; structured dark reticule.
> **C. The Plain Ledger** — unadorned navy, immaculate; authority as competence. Motif: shadow stitching in matching navy, invisible but exact. Thread: **black silk** / **ivory whitework** (the one permitted light, hidden at the hem) / **silver**. Accessories: navy kid gloves; small silver studs; no necklace; tortoiseshell pins, invisible; structured dark reticule.
> *(System: the player commits to a direction — remembered for the confrontation. Each pin costs 5 coins from play earnings; no Crown SKUs touch the ritual. Jewels come from owned pieces only — the jewel shelf is always open but never a ritual step.)*
> (T1 · choice — the direction:) *She commits — A, B, or C; the authority, chosen.* — remembered: *the direction, committed.*
> - **A. The Iron Grey** — *Armor+.* The eye does not slide off her.
> - **B. The Velvet Gavel** — *Certainty+.* The blow cushioned, the verdict not.
> - **C. The Plain Ledger** — *Competence+.* The book balanced, the account closed.

> (T13 · micro-decision) *Pin 12 — the stocking: dark silk; no lightness anywhere in the verdict. 5 coins.* — remembered: *the darkness, pinned.*
> (T14 · micro-decision) *Pin 13 — the reticule: structured, dark; it carries the copying-book's extract, folded small. 5 coins.* — remembered: *the verdict, carried.*
> (T15 · micro-decision) *Pin 14 — the handkerchief: plain linen, pressed; for whatever the clerk does — weeps, or doesn't. 5 coins.* — remembered: *the linen, pinned.*
> (T16 · micro-decision) *Pin 15 — the hair: low chignon, severe; severity reads as certainty to men. 5 coins.* — remembered: *the severity, pinned.*
> (T17 · micro-decision) *Pin 16 — the full accessory set: the direction's earrings, the closed throat, the visible hairpin — every absence deliberate, the set worn complete. 5 coins.* — remembered: *the set, completed.*

scenes.synopsis: The breaking — paid in coin that doesn't come from Quill's office; the S1 letter, intercepted and kept as insurance. (Turns: 8)
scenes.prose:
> *(Alder sits — folding into the chair like a badly filed document — and the breaking begins not with confession, but with arithmetic.)*
> "Seven years." — Alder's voice is very quiet. "Seven years, sir. And the wages — " he stops — "the wages are what they are. And then — " the wet-paper eyes fix on the desk — "then a man came. Last Michaelmas. With — with an arrangement."
> (T1 · look closer) *She listens to the arithmetic — the seven years, the wages; the arrangement, arriving.* — remembered: *the arithmetic, heard.*

> - **The letters** — *Paper+.* Augusta, Quill, the Bath groundwork laid by post.
> *(She chooses the atelier. The book closes on Bath — not yet, not yet — and Rose Hartwell goes down to breakfast with a westward bearing in her head and a tussie-mussie to compose before noon.)*

scenes.synopsis: Quill's confirmation — the cutout, the paymaster, the Bath direction; what Alder gave up, and what it costs to know. (Turns: 7)
scenes.prose:
> Quill came at ten, precise as a ledger entry, with the morning's facts.
> "Alder talked," he said, without preamble. "Through the night, and the talking was comprehensive. The paymaster is not Rackham — as you surmised. The coin that paid my copying clerk came through a cutout — a London man who knows one link and no more — and the cutout's instructions, such as Alder overheard, pointed west. To Bath."
> (T1 · look closer) *Rose studies Quill's face — the mole in his office has cost him sleep.* — remembered: *the cost, worn.*
> "The émigré notes," Rose said. "Bath discounts them. For — whom?"
> "For particular London houses." Quill's mouth was a thin line. "Which houses, the cutout did not say — or Alder did not hear. But the notes are wartime paper, Miss Hartwell. French names. Debts of ruined families, bought for pennies by men who understand that ruin is a commodity." He paused. "Your Mr. Alder is gone. Dismissed, with a character that will not get him another copying room. The price of the knowing."
> (T2 · stance) *She decides what Alder's dismissal means — the trap worked; the price was a clerk's livelihood, and she will carry it.* — remembered: *the price, carried.*
> (T3 · look closer) *She examines the cutout's shape — a man who knows one link; Bath holds the next.* — remembered: *the links, human.*
> (T4 · choice — the papers:)
> - **Ask for the codicil evidence** — *Law+.* The recovered S1 letter, in hand; the evidence, hers to hold or use.
> - **Leave it with Quill** — *Trust+.* The solicitor keeps the papers; Rose keeps her hands clean of the law's pace.
> (T5 · social maneuver) *She asks Quill, as if idly, which Bath banking houses discount émigré paper — the answer, given before he remembers to be careful, is held back: "Not yet. Let me write first."* — remembered: *the name, withheld.*
> (T6 · stance) *She decides to let Quill write first — the law's letters open doors that nerve cannot.* — remembered: *the patience.*
> (T7 · choice — the parting:)
> - **"Find me the houses."** — *Command+.* Tasked, plainly; the bow is a promise.
> - **"Be careful."** — *Care+.* Warned, kindly; his thin smile says he has not been careful in years.
> *(She tasks him, and turns, deliberately, to the week's other front: the dragon's niece, and the flowers.)*

scenes.synopsis: Augusta's counsel — the two fronts; the sponsorship must thrive even as the war moves west; the Dowager's strategy for both. (Turns: 7)
scenes.prose:
> Augusta received her at noon, in the small salon, with the air of a woman who had been expecting the news for a week and was merely gratified to have it confirmed.
> "Bath," the Dowager said. "Yes. The émigré notes have been discounted there since the war's end — ruined French families selling their paper for the price of the waters. Your cutout is the newest link in an old chain." She poured. "And you will not go yet."
> (T1 · look closer) *Rose studies the certainty — Augusta speaks of Bath's money like weather; the Dowager's French past, showing like a slip.* — remembered: *the slip.*
> "Not yet," Rose agreed. "Drummond's price is paid in London — in afternoons, in dances, in the girl. The sponsorship is still tender. A seedling, Augusta. It needs watering before transplanting."
> "A seedling." Augusta's eyebrows rose. "You speak of the Drummond girl like a hothouse plant."
> "She is one. And I am — " Rose stopped, surprised at herself. "I am the gardener. It was not in the arrangement, but there it is."
> (T2 · stance) *She decides the metaphor is true — the sponsorship has become horticulture; neither of them planned it.* — remembered: *the tending.*
> (T3 · choice — the strategy:)
> - **The sponsorship first** — *Society+.* London, Honoria, the dragon's price.
> - **Both fronts at once** — *General+.* Letters west, afternoons east.
> (T4 · look closer) *She examines Augusta's Bath knowledge — the question, asked with the eyes; Augusta answers with the teapot.* — remembered: *the unanswered.*
> "You will write to me from Bath when you go," Augusta said, "and until then, you will make that girl bloom so visibly that Drummond forgets to count the cost." The old eyes were sharp. "And Rose — the tussie-mussie. Well done. Kindness, spent visibly, is the only currency Drummond cannot discount."
> (T5 · tone) *She takes the praise as it is given — the Dowager praises rarely; the praise is real.* — remembered: *the banking.*
> (T6 · social maneuver) *She asks Augusta to mind Drummond — the rear guard, in London; the dragon's leash, held by the one woman the dragon respects.* — remembered: *the rear guard.*
> (T7 · stance) *She leaves with the two fronts ordered — London first, Bath in its season.* — remembered: *the order.*
> *(The door closes on the small salon. Rose goes home to compose flowers.)*

scenes.synopsis: the tussie-mussie, composed — floriography; encouragement, in flowers; the sponsorship made visible. (Turns: 7)
scenes.prose:
> The flower-seller's barrow had the week's best of the late season, and Rose stood over it the way generals stand over maps — choosing, discarding, choosing again.
> A tussie-mussie of encouragement: not apology, not pity. Honoria faced a fitting, a lesson, and a dragon of an aunt; what she needed was a small, fragrant argument that someone was on her side.
> (T1 · look closer) *She studies the barrow — the late asters, the last sweet peas; the flower language, laid out like a vocabulary.* — remembered: *the vocabulary.*
> The choosing was the message:
> Sweet peas — *delicate pleasures.* For the afternoons endured, and the ones to come.
> Heliotrope — *devotion.* For the constancy Rose intended.
> Fern — *sincerity.* For the honesty neither of them would name.
> Rosemary — *remembrance.* For the girl she meant her to become.
> (T2 · choice — the binding:)
> - **White ribbon** — *Purity+.* The posy tied in white; encouragement, unadorned.
> - **Hartwell blue ribbon** — *House+.* The Park's color at the stems; the sponsorship, signed.
> - **No ribbon, just twine** — *Honest+.* Garden twine, plain; the flowers speak for themselves.
> *(She chooses the Hartwell blue. The sponsorship, signed in ribbon — the house behind the girl, visibly.)*
> (T3 · stance) *She decides the posy is not charity — strategy with a scent; the ton will hear of it, and Honoria will hold it.* — remembered: *the strategy, scented.*
> (T4 · social maneuver) *She writes the card — three lines, no more; encouragement, in her own hand, which the girl will keep.* — remembered: *the card.*
> "For Miss Honoria Drummond — to carry into the fitting. Courage, like hemlines, can be let out. — R.H."
> (T5 · look closer) *She re-reads the card — "can be let out"; the modiste's metaphor, deliberate; the girl will understand it in Élise's rooms.* — remembered: *the metaphor.*
> (T6 · remembered micro-decision) *She has the posy delivered by her own footman — not the post; the sponsorship, hand-carried.* — remembered: *the carrying.*
> (T7 · choice — the sending:)
> - **Before the fitting** — *Timing+.* The posy arrives with the morning; Honoria carries it into Élise's rooms.
> - **After the fitting** — *Reward+.* The posy waits at home; the girl's triumph, crowned.
> *(Before. The posy goes with the morning — and Rose feels the campaign shift under her hands: from the war of paper to the war of petals, which is the same war, fought prettier.)*

scenes.synopsis: the delivery — Honoria receives the tussie-mussie; the wallflower, holding flowers. (Turns: 7)
scenes.prose:
> The posy arrived at Drummond House at eleven, in the hands of a Hartwell footman, with the card in Rose's own writing — and Honoria, coming down to breakfast, stopped on the stair like a girl who has walked into a room that is not hers.
> *(The hall: the flowers, the Hartwell blue ribbon, the card. The girl, in a grey morning gown, holding them all as if they might be taken away.)*
> "For me?" she said to the footman, stupidly, and then blushed to the ears at the stupidity. "I mean — thank you. Thank the — Miss Hartwell. Thank her."
> She carried them upstairs — not to the drawing room, where her aunt would inventory them, but to her own sitting room, where she shut the door, read the card three times, and held the posy to her face.
> (T1 · look closer) *She studies the card — "Courage, like hemlines, can be let out"; the metaphor lands; someone has thought about her day, particularly.* — remembered: *the particularity.*
> (T2 · stance) *She decides the flowers are not pity — pity does not choose sweet peas.* — remembered: *the not-pity.*
> (T3 · choice — the keeping:)
> - **Carry it to the fitting** — *Brave+.* The posy goes to Élise's rooms, in her hand; encouragement, worn.
> - **Keep it at home** — *Private+.* The posy stays in water by her bed; encouragement, hoarded.
> *(She carries it. The decision takes ten minutes and all her courage — and the posy goes into her reticule, stems wrapped in damp muslin, like a secret.)*
> (T4 · look closer) *She examines the ribbon — Hartwell blue; the house behind her, visibly; she has never been behind anything before, only beneath.* — remembered: *the behind.*
> (T5 · stance) *She decides to be worthy of the ribbon — the resolution, made privately, with flowers in her reticule.* — remembered: *the resolution.*
> (T6 · social maneuver) *She tells her maid — the one ally in the house — who has watched the girl shrink for years, and nearly weeps into the pressing.* — remembered: *the witness.*
> (T7 · remembered micro-decision) *She writes the thank-you before leaving — four lines, blotted once; gratitude, in a hand that is learning to stand straighter.* — remembered: *the thanks.*
> *(The carriage is called, the posy is in the reticule, and Miss Honoria Drummond goes to her fitting carrying flowers — the first time in her life she has carried anything but apprehension.)*

scenes.synopsis: Honoria's thanks — the note, blotted once; Rose reads what the flowers did, and decides the price is policy. (Turns: 7)
scenes.prose:
> The thank-you came by the afternoon post — four lines, blotted once, in a hand that leaned forward like a girl trying to keep up with her own feelings:
> *"Dear Miss Hartwell — Thank you for the flowers. I have never been sent flowers before a fitting. I carried them in my reticule and the modiste's girl asked what they meant and I told her encouragement, and she said the heliotrope meant devotion, and I did not know what to say to that, so I said nothing, which felt like the right answer. — H.D."*
> (T1 · look closer) *Rose reads the blot — one, at "devotion"; the girl had paused there, pen lifted; the pause is the whole letter.* — remembered: *the pause.*
> "She did not know what to say to devotion," Rose said aloud, to the empty morning room, "so she said nothing, which felt like the right answer." She folded the note with unusual care. "Clever girl."
> (T2 · stance) *She decides the girl is cleverer than her aunt allows — dull is Drummond's word, not the truth; the truth is unwatered, not unwaterable.* — remembered: *the unwatered.*
> (T3 · choice — the filing:)
> - **The drawer** — *Kept+.* With the ribbon, the note, the collection; the sponsorship's correspondence, begun.
> - **The campaign book** — *Filed+.* Pasted among the intelligence; the girl's gratitude, evidenced.
> *(The drawer. The note goes with the ribbon and the rose-note and the rest — the collection of things Rose Hartwell will not admit to keeping.)*
> (T4 · look closer) *She examines what the flowers cost — nothing, in coin; everything, in attention; the cheapest installment of Drummond's price, and the most effective.* — remembered: *the cheapness.*
> (T5 · stance) *She decides kindness is policy — not sentiment, but strategy; the girl who feels backed stands straighter, and the straighter she stands, the better the sponsorship reads.* — remembered: *the policy.*
> (T6 · social maneuver) *She writes back — two lines: "Devotion was exactly right. See you at the fitting. — R.H."* — remembered: *the reply.*
> (T7 · remembered micro-decision) *She underlines "the right answer" in the girl's letter before filing it — the girl's instinct, honored.* — remembered: *the honoring.*
> *(The note is filed, the reply is sent, and Rose — who began the week auditing a dragon's price — finds herself running a different set of books entirely: the girl's, in which the entries are flowers, and the balances are courage.)*

scenes.synopsis: the household, tightened — after Alder, the servants' hall is watched; Letitia's below-stairs diplomacy. (Turns: 7)
scenes.prose:
> "The house is holding its breath," Letitia reported at tea, "which is an improvement on leaking, but not by as much as one might hope."
> Since Alder's dismissal the household had gone very quiet below stairs. The stillroom whispers had dried to a murmur. Mrs. Pye ruled the hall with an iron ladle, and the staff walked softly, as people do in houses where someone has recently been found out.
> (T1 · look closer) *Rose studies the quiet — loyalty, or fear? Not yet clear.* — remembered: *the distinction.*
> "Fear," Letitia said. "For now. Fear first, then habit, then — if we are fortunate — loyalty. You cannot order the last, darling. You can only earn it."
> (T2 · stance) *She decides the hall must be earned, not policed — Mrs. Pye's iron ladle is order; the house needs something warmer, and slower.* — remembered: *the earning.*
> (T3 · choice — the gesture:)
> - **The wages, reviewed** — *Justice+.* Every servant's pay examined; the underpaid, raised; loyalty, bought honestly — or rather, earned honestly.
> - **The notice, softened** — *Mercy+.* No more dismissals without warning; the hall told, plainly, that the trap is over.
> - **Nothing yet** — *Patience+.* Watch one more week; the quiet, studied before it is answered.
> *(The wages. Rose orders the review that afternoon — every book opened, every servant's pay weighed; the house will learn that the mistress who caught the thief also counts the honest.)*
> (T4 · look closer) *She examines Letitia's below-stairs diplomacy — the aunt knows every servant's name; the hall loves her, and the loving is intelligence.* — remembered: *the loving.*
> (T5 · social maneuver) *She asks Letitia to walk the hall — the aunt's rounds, doubled; the servants told, in Letitia's own coin, that the house is safe.* — remembered: *the rounds.*
> (T6 · stance) *She decides the leak is cauterized — Alder gone, the copying room watched; the house can breathe again, when it is ready.* — remembered: *the cauterizing.*
> (T7 · choice — the evening:)
> - **Below stairs herself** — *Nerve+.* Rose walks the hall, plain-dressed; the mistress, seen; the house, steadied by the seeing.
> - **Letitia's rounds suffice** — *Trust+.* The aunt's diplomacy, unshadowed; the hall, given room to breathe.
> *(She goes herself. Plain dress, no announcement — and the servants' hall, holding its breath for a week, exhales at the sight of her: the mistress, in their passage, asking after the wages review by name.)*

scenes.synopsis: Julian, paying — the brother's debts, the quiet installments; the refusal honored, the route warmed by witnessing. (Turns: 7)
scenes.prose:
> She found him in the library at dusk — the club's, not Hartwell's — working among the newspapers like a man hiding in plain sight. Before him: drafts, notes of hand, a solicitor's letter with a French postmark, and a small, neat stack of receipts, growing.
> "The Dieppe note — paid. The Calais tailor — answered, in his own reproachful French, and paid. The London man still buys, quietly, but slower now." He stacked the receipts with care. "Brick by brick, Rose. That is how one unbuilds a cage."
> (T1 · look closer) *She studies the receipts — each one initialed, dated, filed; this is what honor looks like when no one is watching.* — remembered: *the devotion.*
> (T2 · stance) *She decides to honor the refusal — no offer of money, no rescue; the debts are his victory, being built, and she will not diminish it by helping.* — remembered: *the honoring.*
> "You look tired," she said instead.
> "I am tired." He smiled, the charm arriving on time for once. "Tired is honest. Tired means the work is real." He hesitated. "You have not asked — all week, you have not asked how much remains."
> (T3 · choice — the asking:)
> - **Ask now** — *Close+.* "How much remains?" — the question, asked plainly; the trust, mutual.
> - **Do not ask** — *Respect+.* The question, withheld; the cage is his to measure, not hers.
> *(She asks. Plainly. And Julian tells her — the sum, the remaining creditors, the months — and the telling is the trust, and the trust is the route.)*
> (T4 · tone) *She chooses how to hear the sum — without flinching, without pity; the number is a fact, and facts are neutral.* — remembered: *the neutrality.*
> (T5 · social maneuver) *She offers the one thing that is not money — "Tell me when the next is paid. I want to know."* — remembered: *the witnessing.*
> (T6 · stance) *She decides the route is friendship deepening — not named, not rushed.* — remembered: *the weight.*
> (T7 · remembered micro-decision) *She keeps the evening's sum in the campaign book's private page — not as intelligence, but as a trust; some entries are not evidence.* — remembered: *the trust, filed.*
> *(The receipts are stacked, the sum is told, the witnessing is promised. Julian walks her to the club's door at dusk, and the route warms by exactly the width of a told sum.)*

scenes.synopsis: ★ DRESSING RITUAL — a fitting / at-home day; the modiste's rooms; dress for work among muslins. Twenty decomposed micro-decisions at 5 coins each (≈100 coins). Motif × colorway × thread (gold, silver, copper, ivory whitework, steel, black silk, polychrome) × full accessory set, via convergent micro-decisions. Jewels from owned pieces only; the jewel shelf is always open but never a ritual step. (Turns: 21 — direction + 20 pins)
scenes.prose:
> *(System: the occasion brief is published.)*
>
> **Occasion brief — A Working Morning at the Modiste's**
> *Élise's rooms, all day: Honoria's fitting, the clients, the pins, the gossip. The brief is work among muslins — dress to be taken seriously by women who sew for a living, and not to outshine the girl you are launching. Editorial criterion — every choice is judged on competence: does it look like a woman who knows what a fitting is for? Mourning colors forbidden; gloves expected off, not on.*
>
> Rose reads the brief twice, and lays out three directions on the fitting table:
>
> **A. The Draper's Discipline** — slate-blue merino, severe and exact; steel-grey stitching, competence in cloth.
> **B. The Aubergine Hour** — deep aubergine jaconet, copper embroidery at the cuff; authority with warmth, the sponsor as patron.
> **C. The Ivory Ledger** — ivory cambric, black silk embroidery; businesslike, unadorned, the general at work.
>
> *(System: the player commits to a direction — remembered for the fitting day. Then the pins begin. Each pin costs 5 coins from play earnings; no Crown SKUs touch the ritual. Jewels come from owned pieces only — the jewel shelf is always open but never a ritual step.)*
>
> (T1 · choice — the direction) *She commits: A, B, or C — the day's thesis, remembered.*
>
> **Pin 1 (T2 · micro-decision) — The gown's ground:** merino, jaconet, or cambric — the fabric of the working day. *5 coins.*
> **Pin 2 (T3 · micro-decision) — The bodice's cut:** seamed severity, draped ease, or the shirtwaist's plain competence. *5 coins.*
> **Pin 3 (T4 · micro-decision) — The bodice's color:** slate-blue, aubergine, or ivory — each a different authority. *5 coins.*
> **Pin 4 (T5 · micro-decision) — The sleeve's style:** long and plain for the pins, or pushed to the elbow for the work. *5 coins.*
> **Pin 5 (T6 · micro-decision) — The sleeve's fabric:** matching the bodice, or a contrast cambric for the working arm. *5 coins.*
> **Pin 6 (T7 · micro-decision) — The sleeve's color:** tone-on-tone, or a shade deeper — the depth reads as intention. *5 coins.*
> **Pin 7 (T8 · micro-decision) — The neckline:** high for the workroom, modest, or open to the morning. *5 coins.*
> **Pin 8 (T9 · micro-decision) — The skirt's style:** walking length, untrimmed — a working hem. *5 coins.*
> **Pin 9 (T10 · micro-decision) — The skirt's fabric:** the gown's own, or a sturdier twill for the fitting-room floor. *5 coins.*
> **Pin 10 (T11 · micro-decision) — The embroidery motif:** fern (sincerity), heliotrope sprigs (devotion), or the Hartwell rosebud — the day's signature, stitched where the clients will see it. *5 coins.*
>
> *(Story morsel: Élise pins the motif to Rose's cuff and says, "The clients read embroidery the way the ton reads faces, chérie. Choose the thread like you choose your words." The thread drawer opens — gold, silver, copper, ivory whitework, steel, black silk, polychrome — and the workroom goes quiet, the way rooms do when a decision is being made.)*
>
> **Pin 11 (T12 · micro-decision) — The embroidery thread:** gold, silver, copper, ivory whitework, steel, black silk, or polychrome — the motif's voice. *5 coins.*
> **Pin 12 (T13 · micro-decision) — The trim:** braid, cord, or the embroidery alone speaking. *5 coins.*
> **Pin 13 (T14 · micro-decision) — The shoe:** low, certain — for standing all day among pins. *5 coins.*
> **Pin 14 (T15 · micro-decision) — The stocking:** silk, clocked or plain — a workroom notices. *5 coins.*
> **Pin 15 (T16 · micro-decision) — The hair:** coiled for work, no artifice — pins, not curls. *5 coins.*
>
> *(Story morsel: the morning Gazette arrives mid-fitting, and Élise's girl reads Bell's verdict aloud — "charity with excellent posture," not yet written, but the room laughs anyway at the thought of it. Letitia, through the door: "Competence, darling. The brief says competence. Stop fidgeting with the motif.")*
>
> **Pin 16 (T17 · micro-decision) — The hairpiece:** tortoiseshell comb, steel pin, or nothing — the workroom's crown. *5 coins.*
> **Pin 17 (T18 · micro-decision) — The earrings:** small gold hoops, silver drops, copper studs, or none — heard, not seen, among muslins. *5 coins.*
> **Pin 18 (T19 · micro-decision) — The pendant:** cameo, locket, or bare throat — the neckline's answer. *5 coins.*
> **Pin 19 (T20 · micro-decision) — The reticule:** large enough for the tussie-mussie's successor — she will be carrying flowers all week. *5 coins.*
> **Pin 20 (T21 · micro-decision) — The final mirror:** the whole working morning, head to heel, judged against the brief's single question — *does it look like competence?* *5 coins.*
>
> *(Story morsel: at Pin 20, Élise steps back, head tilted, and says, "There. That is a woman the clients will tell things to. A modiste's rooms run on confidence, chérie — yours, and theirs." The thread drawer closes. The motif — fern, heliotrope, or rosebud, in the chosen thread — sits at her cuff like a signature.)*
>
> *(System: 20 pins × 5 coins = 100 coins drawn from play earnings. The completed direction is remembered — the clients will read it. Owned jewels may be added freely from the open shelf at any point, never as a step.)*

ritual.occasionBrief: A Working Morning at the Modiste's. Élise's rooms, all day: Honoria's fitting, the clients, the pins, the gossip. The brief is work among muslins — dress to be taken seriously by women who sew for a living, and not to outshine the girl you are launching. Editorial criterion — every choice is judged on competence: does it look like a woman who knows what a fitting is for? Mourning colors forbidden; gloves expected off, not on.

scenes.synopsis: the reveal coda — the mirror; the working morning, complete; competence, worn. (Turns: 7)
scenes.prose:
> *(System: reveal coda — the ritual's payoff. Rose stands before the glass in the full chosen direction, the working morning complete.)*
> The mirror showed a woman dressed for work — slate-blue merino, or aubergine jaconet, or ivory cambric — the embroidery motif at her cuff in the chosen thread, hair coiled for pins not curls, nothing that apologized, nothing that declared war.
> (T1 · look closer) *She studies the motif at her cuff — fern, heliotrope, or the Hartwell rosebud; the day's signature, stitched where the clients will see it.* — remembered: *the signature.*
> "Well?" she asked the glass.
> The glass showed competence. That was the brief, and the brief was answered — the clients would tell her things, and she would be dressed to hear them.
> (T2 · stance) *She decides the look is right — not beautiful, exactly, but believed; and believed is what the workroom requires.* — remembered: *the belief.*
> (T3 · remembered micro-decision) *She keeps the thread choice — the drawer is closed, the decision stands; re-picks are free, but the first instinct was the true one.* — remembered: *the instinct.*
> (T4 · social maneuver) *She decides how to wear the day — among the muslins, at Honoria's shoulder; the sponsor, visible, working.* — remembered: *the visibility.*
> (T5 · stance) *She sets the ballroom behind her — no performance today, only fittings; the war of petals continues in the workroom.* — remembered: *the workroom.*
> (T6 · choice — the going:)
> - **Early** — *Eager+.* First to the rooms; the workroom, claimed before the clients.
> - **Exactly on time** — *Precise+.* The hour, kept; competence, demonstrated by punctuality.
> (T7 · remembered micro-decision) *She takes up the reticule — large enough for flowers; she will be carrying them all week.* — remembered: *the reticule.*
> *(She goes out into the London morning — dressed for work among muslins, the motif at her cuff — and Élise's rooms, with their pins and gossip and half-finished hems, open their doors to the sponsor.)*

scenes.synopsis: the fitting begins — Honoria in Élise's rooms; the tussie-mussie in her reticule; the workroom's welcome. (Turns: 7)
scenes.prose:
> Élise's rooms smelled of pressed linen and possibility, and Honoria — arriving exactly on time, in the grey morning gown, with the tussie-mussie in her reticule — stood in the doorway like a girl who had been invited to the wrong house and was too polite to leave.
> "Miss Drummond." Élise circled her once, the professional eye missing nothing. "We shall make you *visible*, chérie. Not conspicuous. Visible. There is a difference, and the difference is everything."
> (T1 · look closer) *Rose watches Honoria's face — the girl is terrified and trying not to show it; the trying is visible, which is itself a kind of courage.* — remembered: *the trying.*
> "The posy," Élise said, spotting the reticule's stems. "Heliotrope — devotion. Sweet peas. Rosemary." She looked at Rose, eyebrows raised. "Someone has been speaking the flower language, and speaking it well."
> "Encouragement," Honoria said, very quietly. "Miss Hartwell sent — encouragement."
> (T2 · stance) *Rose decides to let the girl speak for herself — no rescuing, no translating; the fitting is Honoria's, and she must learn to stand in it.* — remembered: *the standing.*
> (T3 · choice — the first commission:)
> - **The afternoon dress** — *Practical+.* For calls, for at-homes; the girl's daily armor, first.
> - **The evening gown** — *Bold+.* For the rout, the ball; the girl's launch, dressed first.
> - **Both, measured today** — *Thorough+.* The wardrobe, begun properly; Élise's eyes gleam at the scope.
> *(Both. The measuring begins — and Honoria, who has never been measured for anything but disappointment, stands very still while the tape goes round her like a promise.)*
> (T4 · look closer) *Rose studies the measuring — the girl's shoulders, hunched; Élise's hands, firm and kind, easing them down as she pins; the fitting as physiotherapy.* — remembered: *the easing.*
> (T5 · social maneuver) *She keeps the workroom easy — talk, tea, the clients' chatter; the fitting must feel like a morning, not an examination.* — remembered: *the ease.*
> (T6 · stance) *She decides the day is working — the girl is straightening by quarter inches; the tape measure is doing what the Season could not.* — remembered: *the quarter inches.*
> (T7 · remembered micro-decision) *She notes the tussie-mussie, laid on the fitting table among the pins — encouragement, among the instruments of transformation.* — remembered: *the placing.*
> *(The tape goes round, the pins go in, and Miss Honoria Drummond begins, by quarter inches, to become visible.)*

scenes.synopsis: fashion as intelligence — the clients gossip while pinned; the atelier hears everything; the émigré notes surface in talk. (Turns: 7)
scenes.prose:

scenes.synopsis: ★ KEY DECISION 1/3 — THE SPONSORSHIP'S MOTIVE. Let Honoria believe it's friendship, tell her it's duty (kindly), or say nothing. (Turns: 3 — the decision itself)
scenes.prose:

> Tell her it was duty — Drummond's price, named kindly, the sponsorship as an obligation that had become something else. The truth, with the edges sanded. The risk: the girl would hear only the price, and the blooming would stop.
> Or say nothing — let the sponsorship be what it was becoming, unexamined; let the flowers and the fittings and the sixty paces speak for themselves. The risk: silence, too, is a kind of story, and stories get written by other people.
*★ KEY DECISION 1/3 — The sponsorship's motive:*
- **Let her believe it's friendship** — *Honoria+, trusted.* The dragon is never named; the sponsorship stands as freely given. Kinder — and the kindest lies are the ones the teller starts to believe.
- **Tell her it's duty, kindly** — *Honoria+, respected.* The price named gently — "My aunt's friend asked it of me; I stayed because of you." Honesty with sanded edges; the girl is treated as an adult.
- **Say nothing** — *Honoria+, unexamined.* No naming, no framing; the sponsorship becomes what it becomes. Silence is its own story — and Rose lets the flowers tell it.
> *(The game remembers the choice — and the means: the words, if any, and the tone they were spoken in. What Honoria believes about the sponsorship will shape everything she becomes.)*

> Three namings. Friendship, deepened — the sittings as refuge, the painter as the truest friend; clean, honest, kept apart from the heart's other business. Romance, acknowledged — the sittings as courtship in all but name; the deepening owned, the painter as more. - **Let it become romance** — *Octavia+, beloved.* The "becoming" owned; the sittings acknowledged as courtship; the painter as more — said plainly, in the north light.
- **Hold it apart from the war** — *Octavia+, separate.* Not named, but guarded — the studio stays the one room where none of it happens; the naming waits, the shelter stands.

scenes.synopsis: Laurent, polished — the family's pressure, the brilliant English match; the émigré notes touch his world. (Turns: 7)
scenes.prose:
> Laurent called at the unfashionable hour of four — which meant, Rose knew, that he had something to say that could not wait for fashion.
> "My family writes," he said, accepting tea with the grace of a man postponing a subject. "The brilliant English match. The de Varenne name, restored. They have selected the weather, and now they are selecting the bride."
> (T1 · look closer) *Rose studies the polish — firmly in place, which means it is working hard; the family's pressure is real, and he is carrying it lightly, which is the heaviest way.* — remembered: *the carrying.*
> "And you?" she asked. "What have you selected?"
> "I have selected — " he paused — "to tell you about it. Which my family would consider the wrong selection entirely." The smile flickered. "The émigré notes, Rose. They touch my world. The ruined families, the discounted paper — the de Varennes know those names. Some of them were — " he stopped. "Were friends. Before."
> (T2 · look closer) *She notes the flicker — mastered, quickly; the polish, doing its work; underneath, something unpolished and worried.* — remembered: *the underneath.*
> (T3 · choice — the answering:)
> - **Press him** — *Close+.* "Tell me which names." — the intelligence, asked for; the polish, tested.
> - **Note it** — *Patient+.* The flicker, filed; the asking, saved for later.
> - **Pretend not to see** — *Kind+.* The polish, respected; the man, given room.
> *(Note it. The flicker is filed — the émigré notes touch his world; the de Varenne bankers are near the trail, and he knows it.)*
> (T4 · stance) *She decides the family pressure is his war — not hers to fight; the brilliant English match, the restored name; she will not compete with a family's weather.* — remembered: *the not-competing.*
> (T5 · tone) *She chooses how to part — warmly, lightly; the route, kept easy; the pressure, not hers to lift.* — remembered: *the lightness.*
> (T6 · social maneuver) *She asks after the family — the polite inquiry; the émigré world, acknowledged without probing.* — remembered: *the acknowledging.*
> (T7 · remembered micro-decision) *She writes in the pocketbook: "Laurent — the notes touch his world. The polish, strained. Watch, kindly."* — remembered: *the watching.*
> *(The tea is finished, the polish restored, and Laurent takes his leave. The route holds, lightly; the war's paper touches his world, and Rose files the flicker under things to watch, kindly.)*

scenes.synopsis: Henry, steady — the Horse Guards whispers; the army's money once moved like dispatches; the route, steadied. (Turns: 7)
scenes.prose:
> Henry called at dusk — the uniform, the man, no flattery; he came, as he always came, like a fact.
> "The Horse Guards whispers," he said, standing, as if the news required parade rest. "The army's money once moved like dispatches — sealed, routed, signed for. Someone at the Guards has noticed that certain civilian houses move money the same way now. The dispatch system, in civilian dress."
> (T1 · look closer) *Rose studies the steadiness — no polish, no charm; the uniform, the man; the intelligence, offered plainly.* — remembered: *the plainness.*
> "Voss and Hallett," she said. "The London front."
> "Among others." He met her eyes. "The Guards are — watching. Quietly. I thought you should know the watching has company."
> (T2 · stance) *She decides the intelligence is gold — the dispatch system, confirmed; the Network moves money like armies move orders; Henry knows the system.* — remembered: *the confirming.*
> (T3 · choice — the asking:)
> - **Ask him to map it** — *Bold+.* The routes, the houses; the soldier, tasked.
> - **Keep him out of danger** — *Careful+.* The Guards' watching, not his; the man, protected.
> - **Report it to Augusta** — *Cautious+.* The Dowager's counsel; the intelligence, shared upward.
> *(Keep him out. The words come before the strategy — "Not you. Not in it." — and Henry, who expected to be tasked, looks at her for a long moment, and nods.)*
> (T4 · look closer) *She examines the nod — the soldier, accepting protection he did not ask for; the route, warming by the width of the refusal.* — remembered: *the warming.*
> (T5 · tone) *She chooses how to say it — plainly, the way he speaks; no flattery, just position.* — remembered: *the plainness, returned.*
> "The uniform stays out of the civilian war," she said. "That is an order, Major."
> "Yes, miss," he said — and smiled, the rare, unguarded one. "Disobeyed at the first opportunity, of course."
> (T6 · stance) *She decides the route is steadiness — no drama, no polish; the man who offers auditors, not flattery; the uniform, the man.* — remembered: *the steadiness.*
> (T7 · remembered micro-decision) *She writes in the pocketbook: "Henry — the dispatch system, confirmed. Keep him out. (He will disobey.)"* — remembered: *the disobedience, expected.*
> *(The dusk holds, the uniform goes, and Henry leaves Rose with the dispatch system confirmed and the route steadied.)*

> - **Herself, in time** — *Nerve+.* The road, walked when the season allows; the house, seen with her own eyes.
> - **The atelier's ears** — *Subtle+.* Élise's Bath woman, tasked; the gossip, mined deeper.
> *(All three. The game remembers the order — the law first, the ears always, herself when the season allows.)*

> *(Both. The flowers are ordered, the book stays open — and Rose Hartwell, who began the week with Bath as a single underlined word, ends it with a Bath house named, a phrase in ink, and a road decided.)*
