scenes.synopsis: ★ DRESSING RITUAL — the Bath assembly; evening dress; no longer invisible; the brief is attention. Twenty decomposed micro-decisions at 5 coins each (≈100 coins). Jewels from owned pieces only; the jewel shelf is always open but never a ritual step. (Turns: 21 — direction + 20 pins)
scenes.prose:
> *(System: the occasion brief is published.)*
>
> **Occasion brief — The Bath Assembly**
> *Evening. The assembly rooms, the banking houses, the carriers, Voss himself. The brief is attention: evening dress for a woman who is done being underestimated and means to be seen seeing. Editorial criterion — every choice is judged on whether it says* I am watching, *without saying a word about what she watches. Invisible is retired; attentive is the thesis.*
>
> Rose reads the brief twice, and lays out three directions on the table:
>
> **A. The Watchful Jewel** — deep sapphire silk, silver trim; attention as ornament, the eye drawn and drawing.
> **B. The Severe Evening** — black crape over pearl, jet at the throat; attention as authority, the surveyor's dress.
> **C. The Bright Signal** — emerald satin, gold at the wrist; attention as confidence, the woman who need not hide.
>
> *(System: the player commits to a direction — remembered for the assembly. Then the pins begin. Each pin costs 5 coins from play earnings; no Crown SKUs touch the ritual. Jewels come from owned pieces only — the jewel shelf is always open but never a ritual step.)*
>
> (T1 · choice — the direction) *She commits: A, B, or C — the evening's thesis, remembered.*
>
> **Pin 2 (T2 · micro-decision) — The gown's ground:** silk, satin, or crape — the fabric of attention. *5 coins.*
> **Pin 3 (T3 · micro-decision) — The gown's color:** sapphire, black-and-pearl, or emerald — each a different watching. *5 coins.*
> **Pin 4 (T4 · micro-decision) — The bodice's cut:** seamed severity or draped ease. *5 coins.*
> **Pin 5 (T5 · micro-decision) — The neckline:** high (reserve), modest (candor), or low (dare) — each a sentence. *5 coins.*
> **Pin 6 (T6 · micro-decision) — The sleeve:** long and close, or short with the long glove. *5 coins.*
> **Pin 7 (T7 · micro-decision) — The skirt's sweep:** trained, for the entrance. *5 coins.*
> **Pin 8 (T8 · micro-decision) — The overskirt:** crape, lace, or none — the evening's depth. *5 coins.*
> **Pin 9 (T9 · micro-decision) — The trim:** silver, jet, or gold — the thesis, in miniature. *5 coins.*
> **Pin 10 (T10 · micro-decision) — The shoe:** satin, heeled, certain. *5 coins.*
>
> *(Story morsel: Letitia looks in, sees the sapphire — or the crape, or the emerald — and says, "Oh, my love. The invisible girl is gone. Whatever you are watching tonight, it had better be worth the watching." Rose does not answer, which is answer enough.)*
>
> **Pin 11 (T11 · micro-decision) — The glove:** long, kid, exact. *5 coins.*
> **Pin 12 (T12 · micro-decision) — The glove's color:** white, black, or grey — each a different hand. *5 coins.*
> **Pin 13 (T13 · micro-decision) — The hair:** dressed high, for the room's sightlines. *5 coins.*
> **Pin 14 (T14 · micro-decision) — The hairpiece:** feather, comb, or bandeau — height, as strategy. *5 coins.*
> **Pin 15 (T15 · micro-decision) — The earring:** drops, catching the candlelight — to be seen seeing. *5 coins.*
> **Pin 16 (T16 · micro-decision) — The necklace:** pearl, jet, or gold — the throat's sentence. *5 coins.*
> **Pin 17 (T17 · micro-decision) — The fan:** ivory, painted — the watcher's tool, and weapon. *5 coins.*
> **Pin 18 (T18 · micro-decision) — The reticule:** small, for the campaign book's absence — tonight the book stays home. *5 coins.*
> **Pin 19 (T19 · micro-decision) — The scent:** orange water — innocence, worn like armor. *5 coins.*
> **Pin 20 (T20 · micro-decision) — The posture rehearsal:** the entrance — chin, shoulders, the door-handling of a woman who is done being underestimated. *5 coins.*
> **Pin 21 (T21 · micro-decision) — The final mirror:** the whole attention, head to heel, judged against the brief's single question — *does it say I am watching?* *5 coins.*
>
> *(Story morsel: at the final pin, Rose looks at the girl in the glass — sapphire, crape, or emerald — and the girl looks back with the particular expression of a general before a survey. "No longer invisible," Rose says aloud. The glass agrees.)*
>
> *(System: 20 pins × 5 coins = 100 coins drawn from play earnings. The completed direction is remembered. Owned jewels may be added freely from the open shelf at any point, never as a step.)*

scenes.synopsis: the reveal coda — the mirror; no longer invisible; attention, worn. (Turns: 7)
scenes.prose:
> *(System: reveal coda — the ritual's payoff. Rose stands before the glass in the full chosen direction, the attentive evening complete.)*
> The mirror showed a woman, not a girl — sapphire, or crape-and-pearl, or emerald — with her hair dressed high and her fan in her hand and the particular stillness of someone who has decided to be seen.
> (T1 · look closer) *She studies the woman in the glass — the season's work, written on her; the Assembly's heroine, the masquerade's watcher, Bath's surveyor, all at once.* — remembered: *the woman.*
> (T2 · stance) *She decides the look is right — not beautiful, exactly, though it is; but attentive, which is the evening's whole ambition.* — remembered: *the attention, worn.*
> (T3 · remembered micro-decision) *She takes up the fan — ivory, painted; the watcher's tool, and weapon.* — remembered: *the fan.*
> (T4 · social maneuver) *She rehearses the entrance — the pause at the door, the sweep of the room, the exact moment to begin seeing.* — remembered: *the entrance, rehearsed.*
> (T5 · stance) *She sets the plain-clothes behind her — retired, not discarded; invisibility was a tactic, not an identity.* — remembered: *the tactic, retired.*
> (T6 · choice — the evening's vow:)*
> - **"Watch, do not touch."** — *Discipline+.* The survey's rule, spoken aloud.
> - **"See everything."** — *Ambition+.* The survey's scope, spoken aloud.
> - **"No longer invisible."** — *Declaration+.* The thesis, spoken aloud.
> (T7 · remembered micro-decision) *She leaves the campaign book home — tonight's evidence will be carried in memory, the way the voice was.* — remembered: *the memory, tasked.*
> The fan was heavier than it looked — ivory sticks, painted silk — and Rose practiced the gesture twice: the half-open hold that hides a smile, the snap shut that ends a conversation. In the glass, the woman practiced too — sapphire catching the candlelight, the earrings throwing small sparks. Somewhere below, Letitia was telling the coachman to wait. The surveyor was ready. The room would see a lady in sapphire, attentive and complete — and never guess she was carrying the evening's ledger in her head, every link of the chain memorized like the steps of a dance she had rehearsed all week.
> *(She goes down to the carriage — attentive, complete, unmissable — and Bath, which has watched her all season in muslins designed to be overlooked, is about to see what it has been overlooking.)*

scenes.chapterTitle: Note to Carrier to Banking House
scenes.synopsis: ★ FASHION-SELECTION — no coin cost, remembered. The assembly's finishing statement: the wrap, the entrance's last word. (Turns: 7)
scenes.prose:
> *(System: fashion-selection — diegetic, no coin cost. The choice is remembered and will surface in the room's reading of her.)*
> "The wrap," Letitia said, laying three across the bed — the gown complete, the evening nearly sealed, only the last word to choose. "The assembly rooms are draughty, the entrance is everything, and Mrs. Nance Bell will have an opinion by morning. The wrap is the sentence's end. Choose the ending."
>
> **A. The Silver Shawl** — cashmere, soft, trailing; attention made graceful, the watcher as lady.
> **B. The Black Velvet Cloak** — severe, hooded; attention made formidable, the watcher as fate.
> **C. The Emerald Mantle** — bright, sweeping; attention made triumphant, the watcher as victor.
>
> *(System: no coin cost. The selection is remembered — the room will read it.)*
> (T1 · choice) *She chooses — A, B, or C; the entrance's last word.*
> (T2 · look closer) *She studies each wrap's reading — the shawl says grace, the cloak says fate, the mantle says victory; the room will translate.* — remembered: *the translation.*
> (T3 · stance) *She decides how to carry it — the shawl trailing, the cloak hooded, the mantle sweeping; the carriage, the steps, the door.* — remembered: *the carrying.*
> (T4 · social maneuver) *She times the entrance — not first, not last; the exact moment when the room is full enough to see and empty enough to notice.* — remembered: *the timing.*
> (T5 · look closer) *She considers Voss — the front's man, in the room tonight; what will the wrap say to him?* — remembered: *the message.*
> (T6 · remembered micro-decision) *She takes Letitia's arm at the carriage — the aunt's steadiness, borrowed; the entrance, shared.* — remembered: *the arm.*
> (T7 · stance) *She sets her face — attentive, complete; the survey begins at the door.* — remembered: *the face.*
> Rose chose — shawl, cloak, or mantle — and Letitia arranged it with the gravity of a general issuing the last order. "Well," the aunt said, "whatever you are watching tonight, it will know it is being watched. Whether that is a warning or an invitation is entirely up to you."

scenes.chapterTitle: Note to Carrier to Banking House
scenes.synopsis: the assembly rooms — arrival; the room, the carriers, the banking men. (Turns: 8)
scenes.prose:
> The assembly rooms were lit like a promise — candles, music, the particular brilliance of Bath at its most deliberate — and Rose entered them the way she had rehearsed: the pause at the door, the sweep of the room, the exact moment to begin seeing.
> *(The room: the ballroom's length, the card room's door ajar, the supper room beyond; the banking men in clusters, the carriers at the edges, Voss — the watch-chain man, unmasked tonight, unmistakable — holding court near the supper room.)*
> (T1 · look closer) *She inventories the room — Sykes, Parry, the Bath houses; the carriers' masters; the clerks at the edges; the money's Bath garrison, in evening dress.* — remembered: *the garrison, inventoried.*
> (T2 · look closer) *She places Voss — unmasked, confident, the watch-chain catching the candlelight; the front's man, in his element.* — remembered: *Voss, placed.*
> (T3 · stance) *She decides the evening's first truth — they do not know they are mapped; the confidence is genuine, which makes it useful.* — remembered: *the confidence, useful.*
> (T4 · social maneuver) *She makes the entrance's rounds — the greetings, the smiles, the exact degree of attention paid to each; the watcher, performing the watched.* — remembered: *the performance.*
> (T5 · look closer) *She notes the card room — men writing, as predicted; the note's birthplace, in session.* — remembered: *the birthplace.*
> (T6 · stance) *She takes her station — in motion, as planned; she dances, she sups, she moves — and watches from everywhere, like weather.* — remembered: *the weather.*
> (T7 · choice — the first dance:)*
> - **With a banking man** — *Access+.* Sykes's partner, or Parry's; the money's ear, borrowed for a set.
> - **With a stranger** — *Freedom+.* No one's partner, no one's business; the floor, surveyed from its center.
> - **Not yet** — *Patience+.* The edge, the fan, the watching; the dance can wait, the chain cannot.
> (T8 · remembered micro-decision) *She fixes the evening's order in her head — note, carrier, banking house; the three links, the one evening.* — remembered: *the order.*
> *(The music starts. The room turns. And Rose Hartwell — no longer invisible, attentive, complete — begins the survey.)*

scenes.chapterTitle: Note to Carrier to Banking House
scenes.synopsis: the carriers, noted — faces placed; the chain's hands, in the room. (Turns: 8)
scenes.prose:
> By the second set, the carriers had declared themselves — not by announcement, but by habit. Men who carry do not dance the way men who stay do; they keep their coats buttoned, their eyes on the doors, their partners at arm's length, as if the evening were an errand.
> *(Three of them: the clerk from the White Hart; a thin man with a dispatch case; a boy — no, a young man — with the particular stillness of someone waiting to be sent.)*
> (T1 · look closer) *She studies the clerk — the White Hart's coffee-drinker, transformed; evening dress, but the door-watching habit intact.* — remembered: *the habit.*
> (T2 · look closer) *She studies the dispatch case — locked, carried like a child; what requires a locked case at an assembly?* — remembered: *the case.*
> (T3 · look closer) *She studies the young man — the stillness; he is the one who will be sent, she decides; the chain's youngest hand.* — remembered: *the youngest hand.*
> (T4 · stance) *She decides the carriers are the chain's truth — the notes can be forged, the bankers can lie, but the hands tell where the money goes.* — remembered: *the hands, the truth.*
> (T5 · choice — the thread:)*
> - **The clerk** — *Known+.* The mapped face; follow the known thread, see where it leads tonight.
> - **The dispatch case** — *Curious+.* The locked case; the most interesting object in the room.
> - **The young man** — *Patient+.* The stillness; the one who waits will be worth the waiting.
> (T6 · social maneuver) *She arranges to be near the card room's door — a word with the assembly-master's sister, a laugh, a position; the watcher, placed.* — remembered: *the placing.*
> (T7 · remembered micro-decision) *She notes the time — the evening's ledger, begun in her head; every movement, timestamped.* — remembered: *the ledger.*
> (T8 · stance) *She decides the carriers do not know her — or do not know she knows them; either way, the advantage is hers.* — remembered: *the advantage.*
> *(The carriers move through the evening like errands in evening dress — and Rose, who has memorized their hands, watches the hands.)*

scenes.chapterTitle: Note to Carrier to Banking House
scenes.synopsis: the note — hand to hand; the chain's first link, seen. (Turns: 8)
scenes.prose:
> It happened in the card room's doorway — quick, practiced, almost invisible: the thin man with the dispatch case wrote, folded, and passed. A note. Hand to hand. The chain's first link, forged in the open.
> *(The card room: the scratch of pens, the murmur of stakes, the thin man at the writing desk, the fold, the pass — to the clerk, who pocketed it without breaking stride.)*
> (T1 · look closer) *She studies the note's birth — written, not carried in; the message composed tonight, for tonight; the chain is live.* — remembered: *the liveness.*
> (T2 · look closer) *She studies the fold — thrice-folded, like Cecilia's paper; the Network folds the same way everywhere, a habit, a signature.* — remembered: *the fold.*
> (T3 · look closer) *She studies the pass — the clerk's pocket, the unbroken stride; practiced, regular; this has happened a hundred times.* — remembered: *the practice.*
> (T4 · stance) *She decides not to intercept — the rule holds: watch, do not touch; the note must reach its carrier, the carrier his house.* — remembered: *the rule, held.*
> (T5 · choice — the note's nature:)*
> - **Orders** — *Command+.* The thin man commands; the clerk obeys; the chain is a hierarchy.
> - **Intelligence** — *Report+.* The thin man reports; the clerk carries upward; the chain is a nervous system.
> - **Money** — *Value+.* The note is itself value — a draft, a direction; the chain is the money.
> (T6 · social maneuver) *She keeps her face — the fan, the smile, the dance just ended; no one sees the watcher see.* — remembered: *the face, kept.*
> (T7 · remembered micro-decision) *She timestamps it — the evening's ledger: the note, the hour, the hands.* — remembered: *the timestamp.*
> (T8 · stance) *She decides the first link is confirmed — note to carrier; two links remain, and the evening is young.* — remembered: *the confirmation.*
> The card room smelled of wax and money — the particular perfume of stakes laid and lost. At the writing desk, the thin man wrote without hurry, blotting with care, as if the note were correspondence of the most ordinary kind. Around him the play went on: the murmur of bets, the click of counters, a laugh too loud from a young officer losing gracefully. Nobody watched the desk. That was the point, Rose understood — the chain's first link was forged in the one place where writing was invisible, because everyone was always writing. The ordinary, weaponized.
> *(The clerk moves off, the note in his pocket, the stride unbroken. Rose watches him go — and follows, at the room's pace, like weather.)*

scenes.chapterTitle: Note to Carrier to Banking House
scenes.synopsis: the carrier to the banking house's man — the full circuit, in one evening. (Turns: 8)
scenes.prose:
> The clerk crossed the ballroom — unhurried, unremarkable — and in the supper room's doorway, he passed the note on. To Sykes. Of Sykes & Drum. Who discounts for Voss & Hallett. The chain's third link, closed in the open, over supper.
> *(The supper room: the clatter, the candlelight, Sykes receiving the note with his soup, reading it under the table's edge, nodding once — to Voss, across the room.)*
> Note to carrier to banking house. The full circuit, in one evening. Rose stood in the ballroom's doorway with her fan half-open and watched money move — and understood, with the particular clarity of the surveyor, that she was seeing the season's whole war in miniature.
> (T1 · look closer) *She studies Sykes's nod — to Voss, across the room; the banking house reports to the front, in the open, like a subordinate.* — remembered: *the nod.*
> (T2 · stance) *She decides the circuit is complete — note, carrier, banking house; the chain draws itself, as predicted.* — remembered: *the circuit.*
> (T3 · choice — the meaning:)*
> - **A hierarchy** — *Order+.* Voss commands, Sykes obeys, the clerk carries; the Network is an army.
> - **A market** — *Trade+.* Voss buys, Sykes discounts, the clerk delivers; the Network is a business.
> - **Both** — *Truth+.* Armies and businesses, unseparated; the Network is both, as wars are.
> (T4 · look closer) *She studies Voss receiving the nod — the satisfaction, the settledness; he does not know he is mapped.* — remembered: *the unknowing.*
> (T5 · social maneuver) *She keeps her station — the ballroom's doorway, the fan, the dance waiting; the watcher, unmoved.* — remembered: *the station, kept.*
> (T6 · stance) *She decides what the circuit buys her — not the note's contents, but the chain's shape; shapes can be broken, contents merely read.* — remembered: *the shape.*
> (T7 · remembered micro-decision) *She commits the circuit to memory — the hands, the hours, the nod; the evening's ledger, complete.* — remembered: *the ledger, complete.*
> (T8 · choice — the evening's turn:)*
> - **Keep watching** — *Patience+.* The night is young; the chain may run again, and twice is evidence.
> - **Begin the naming** — *Nerve+.* The circuit seen; the reckoning, begun — in her head, if not aloud.
> *(She keeps watching — and the chain, obliging, runs again: another note, another carrier, another nod. Twice is evidence. And Rose Hartwell, who came to survey, stays to witness.)*

scenes.chapterTitle: Note to Carrier to Banking House
scenes.synopsis: the supper room — Trelawney's cover in action; the banking men's talk, overheard. (Turns: 8)
scenes.prose:
> Trelawney asked his question about the funds loudly, exactly as instructed — and the supper room, obliging, answered at length.
> *(The supper table: Sykes, Parry, two Bath houses; the talk of discount rates, of London paper, of obligations bought and sold; Trelawney among them, the frightened banker performing curiosity.)*
> "Voss and Hallett are buying Bath paper," Parry said, over the fish. "Obligations — mortgages, mostly. Country houses." He laughed. "Somebody in London has developed a taste for other people's roofs."
> "Hartwell paper among it?" Trelawney asked — lightly, oh so lightly.
> The table paused. Just a breath. "Some," Sykes said.
> (T1 · look closer) *Rose studies the pause — the breath before "Some"; the table knows the name Hartwell, and knows it is watching.* — remembered: *the pause.*
> (T2 · look closer) *She studies Trelawney's performance — the frightened banker, asking lightly; the cover holds, and the game one plays within it.* — remembered: *the performance.*
> (T3 · stance) *She decides the supper room is the chain's mouth — where the money talks, after it moves; the notes' echo, in conversation.* — remembered: *the echo.*
> (T4 · choice — the listening:)*
> - **The rates** — *Money+.* What they pay for the paper; the price of a roof, in London's market.
> - **The names** — *Intelligence+.* Whose paper, besides Hartwell's; the buying's full scope.
> - **The London taste** — *Motive+.* Somebody in London — who? The name behind the appetite.
> (T5 · social maneuver) *She keeps her seat — the ladies' end, the fan, the soup; the watcher, dining.* — remembered: *the dining.*
> (T6 · look closer) *She notes who does not speak — Sykes, mostly; the man who received the note eats quietly, and watches Voss.* — remembered: *the quiet.*
> (T7 · stance) *She decides Sykes is the chain's weakest link — the receiver, not the commander; the man who nods across rooms can be made to talk.* — remembered: *the weakness.*
> (T8 · remembered micro-decision) *She memorizes Parry's phrase — "a taste for other people's roofs"; the Network's appetite, in a banker's joke.* — remembered: *the phrase.*
> *(The supper ends. The talk disperses. And Rose carries Parry's joke home in her head like a specimen — somebody in London, with a taste for roofs; the evening's ledger gains its wittiest, truest line.)*

scenes.chapterTitle: Note to Carrier to Banking House
scenes.synopsis: Voss at close range — the front's man, conversing; sly, confident, unknowing. (Turns: 8)
scenes.prose:
> He found her by the supper room's door — Voss, the watch-chain, the confidence — and bowed with the particular courtesy of a man who has decided to be charming.
> "Miss Hartwell. We meet again — though the mask, I think, suited us both better. One says things, masked, that the evening light would blush at."
> "Does one," Rose said. "I said nothing, masked, that I would not say in daylight."
> "Then you are either very honest," Voss said, "or very careful. I have not decided which I prefer."
> (T1 · look closer) *She studies him unmasked — the confidence, genuine; he does not know he is mapped, and the not-knowing is his whole armor.* — remembered: *the armor.*
> (T2 · tone) *She chooses her register — the season's whole education, in a voice.*
> - **Pleasant** — *Grace+.* The lady, conversing; Voss relaxed, and talkative.
> - **Direct** — *Nerve+.* The surveyor, undisguised; Voss alert, and interested.
> - **Cool** — *Distance+.* The wall, politely maintained; Voss curious, and cautious.
> (T3 · look closer) *She studies the watch-chain — the same chain, the same glint; the paymaster's ornament, worn like a medal.* — remembered: *the medal.*
> (T4 · stance) *She decides what he is — not the principal; the front's man, the confident agent; the voice at the masquerade was not his — this voice is flatter, quicker — and the distinction matters.* — remembered: *the distinction.*
> (T5 · choice — the probe:)*
> - **The mortgages** — *Bold+.* "You buy country paper, I hear." — said lightly; Voss's smile, measured.
> - **The evening** — *Safe+.* "Bath agrees with you, Mr. Voss?" — the weather, weaponized.
> - **The mask** — *Playful+.* "What did you say, masked, that daylight would blush at?" — the question, returned.
> (T6 · social maneuver) *She watches his hands as he answers — still, unhurried; the man has nothing to hide tonight, because tonight's work is done.* — remembered: *the stillness.*
> (T7 · look closer) *She considers what his confidence buys her — a man who does not know he is mapped will map himself, given room.* — remembered: *the room, given.*
> (T8 · remembered micro-decision) *She ends it first — the curtsy, the smile, the withdrawal; never let the front's man choose the conversation's end.* — remembered: *the ending, chosen.*
> *("A pleasure, Miss Hartwell," Voss said to her retreating back — and Rose, who had watched his chain run twice in one evening, permitted herself, in the ballroom's doorway, the smallest of smiles.)*

scenes.chapterTitle: Note to Carrier to Banking House
scenes.synopsis: the naming — in her head, the London face: Lucien de Valcourt, the Network's financier. (Turns: 8)
scenes.prose:
> In the ballroom's doorway, between dances, Rose named him — in her head, where naming is safe.
> *Lucien de Valcourt.* The signature, in the deed box. The margin, in the masquerade's paper. The account — No. 9, Greville Street, Hatton Garden; ask for the de Valcourt account. The London face, given a name at last.
> *(The room turning around her; the name, settling into place like a key into a lock.)*
> (T1 · look closer) *She assembles the evidence — the signature, the margin, the account, Augusta's flicker; four points, one name; the case, made.* — remembered: *the case.*
> (T2 · stance) *She decides what he is — not a clerk, not an agent; the Network's London financier; the money behind the front.* — remembered: *the financier.*
> (T3 · look closer) *She examines his want — the mortgages, the forced sale; Hartwell Park, bought roof by roof; Rackham's scattered paper, suppressed before it evidences the pattern.* — remembered: *the want.*
> (T4 · stance) *She decides the want's shape — not malice, exactly; appetite. Somebody in London has developed a taste for other people's roofs — and the somebody has a name.* — remembered: *the appetite.*
> (T5 · choice — the name's weight:)*
> - **A weapon** — *Nerve+.* Spoken, the name becomes a threat; the Network will know it is named.
> - **A secret** — *Reserve+.* Held, the name becomes leverage; the Network, unnamed, stays unwarned.
> - **A question** — *Curiosity+.* The name, investigated; who is Lucien de Valcourt, in London's daylight?
> (T6 · look closer) *She considers the masquerade's voice — educated, unhurried; was it his? A principal, or near one — the theory, tested against the name.* — remembered: *the test.*
> (T7 · stance) *She decides the voice can wait — the name is the quarry now; voices follow names, not the reverse.* — remembered: *the order.*
> (T8 · remembered micro-decision) *She writes the name in her head's campaign book — Lucien de Valcourt; the London face, named.* — remembered: *the naming.*
> *(The dance ends. The room applauds. And Rose Hartwell stands in the applause with a financier's name in her head — the season's whole war, given its London face.)*

scenes.chapterTitle: Note to Carrier to Banking House
scenes.synopsis: ★ KEY DECISION 1/3 — THE NAME. Speak it aloud in Bath, keep it for London, or tell only Augusta and Quill. (Turns: 3 — the decision itself)
scenes.prose:
> The name sat in her head like a live coal — *Lucien de Valcourt* — and the evening, Rose understood, was offering her the choice of what to do with fire.
> Speak it aloud, here, in Bath — in the supper room, over the fish; let the banking men hear the Network's London face named, and watch the room flinch. Keep it for London — hold the coal till she stands on Greville Street herself, and spend it where it burns hottest. Or tell only Augusta and Quill — the aunt's judgment, the solicitor's law; the name, armed and aimed, but not yet fired.
*★ KEY DECISION 1/3 — The de Valcourt name:*
- **Speak it aloud in Bath** — *Nerve+, the name as weapon.* The supper room hears it; the Network learns, tonight, that it is named — and the war goes open.
- **Keep it for London** — *Patience+, the name as reserve.* The coal banked; Greville Street will hear it first, from her own mouth, on her own ground.
- **Tell only Augusta and Quill** — *Counsel+, the name as instrument.* The aunt and the solicitor, armed; the name aimed through judgment and law, fired when they choose.
> *(The game remembers the choice — and the means: the tone of the speaking, or the discipline of the silence. The name's fate is the chapter's first seal.)*

scenes.chapterTitle: Note to Carrier to Banking House
scenes.synopsis: the name's consequence — whatever was chosen, the evening absorbs it; the chain, meanwhile, runs a third time. (Turns: 8)
scenes.prose:
> What she did with the name, she did — and the evening absorbed it the way rooms absorb everything: a ripple, or a silence, or nothing at all, each equally data.
> *(The ballroom, the third hour; the chain, obliging, running a third time — the thin man writing, the clerk carrying, Sykes receiving; thrice is pattern, thrice is proof.)*
> (T1 · choice — the reading:)*
> - **The ripple** — *If spoken: the supper room's pause, the glances; the Network, warned.* — remembered: *the warning.*
> - **The silence** — *If held: the evening's smoothness, undisturbed; the coal, banked.* — remembered: *the banking.*
> - **The counsel** — *If shared: Augusta's nod, Quill's letter drafted in her head; the name, aimed.* — remembered: *the aiming.*
> (T2 · look closer) *She studies the third run — the same hands, the same fold, the same nod; the chain does not vary, because the chain does not know.* — remembered: *the invariance.*
> (T3 · stance) *She decides thrice is proof — the survey is complete; the circuit is not an incident but a system.* — remembered: *the system.*
> (T4 · social maneuver) *She dances the third set — with Parry, who talked of roofs; the banker's joke, revisited in motion.* — remembered: *the revisit.*
> (T5 · look closer) *She notes Voss's evening — the confidence undimmed; whatever the name did, the front's man does not show it.* — remembered: *the undimmed.*
> (T6 · stance) *She decides the evening has given all it will — the circuit, the name, the proof; what remains is the reckoning.* — remembered: *the reckoning, queued.*
> (T7 · remembered micro-decision) *She signals Trelawney — the dropped glove, the turned ring; the banker's watch, ended.* — remembered: *the signal, given.*
> (T8 · choice — the night's last act:)*
> - **Stay** — *Society+.* The evening out, the dances danced; the surveyor, seen enjoying the survey.
> - **Go** — *War+.* The carriage, the lodgings, the book; the evidence, committed to ink while fresh.
> The ripple, if ripple there was, moved the way ripples move in ballrooms — a pause in a conversation, resumed; a glance exchanged over a fan; Sykes setting down his glass with a care that was almost, but not quite, natural. Or the silence held — the evening's smoothness undisturbed, the coal banked, the name a live thing in her head and nowhere else. Either way, the chain ran its third circuit beneath the music, indifferent to what she had done with the name. The money did not care about drama. It only moved.
> *(She goes. The carriage, the night streets, the campaign book waiting — and Rose Hartwell carries the evening home like a dispatch: the circuit, the name, the proof, all of it, fresh.)*

scenes.chapterTitle: Note to Carrier to Banking House
scenes.synopsis: the lodgings, near midnight — the evening committed to the campaign book. (Turns: 7)
scenes.prose:
> Near midnight. The campaign book open, the pen moving, the evening's ledger committed to ink while fresh.
> *(The book: NOTE — the thin man, the card room, the thrice-folded fold. CARRIER — the clerk, the dispatch case, the young man. BANKING HOUSE — Sykes, the nod, Voss across the room. Thrice run. Pattern. Proof.)*
> (T1 · remembered micro-decision) *She writes the circuit — the three links, the three runs; the chain, drawn.* — remembered: *the drawing.*
> (T2 · remembered micro-decision) *She writes the name — Lucien de Valcourt; the London face, in ink at last.* — remembered: *the ink.*
> (T3 · remembered micro-decision) *She writes the want — the mortgages, the forced sale, Rackham's scattered paper suppressed.* — remembered: *the want, filed.*
> (T4 · stance) *She decides the book is now a weapon — not a diary; evidence, organized; the war's case, building.* — remembered: *the weapon.*
> (T5 · look closer) *She reviews the week's pages — Cecilia, the voice, the direction, the circuit; the chapter, whole.* — remembered: *the whole.*
> (T6 · choice — the book's close:)*
> - **Lock it** — *Guarded+.* The drawer, the key; the evidence, secured.
> - **Copy it** — *Prudent+.* The fair copy for Quill; the law, armed with the evening.
> (T7 · stance) *She decides she is no longer the person being moved — the book proves it; the watcher has become the witness, and the witness will become the actor.* — remembered: *the becoming.*
> The pen scratched — the good pen, the campaign pen — and the ink laid down the evening in her small, exact hand. NOTE: the thin man, the card room, the thrice-folded fold. CARRIER: the clerk, the dispatch case, the young man's stillness. BANKING HOUSE: Sykes, the nod, Voss across the room. Three runs. Pattern. Proof. The house was silent around her — Letitia abed, the maid gone, only the fire settling in the grate. Somewhere in London, she thought, a clerk was writing too. But her book was the one that mattered.
> *(The book closes. The lamp is turned down. And Rose Hartwell — who began the season being moved like a piece — sleeps with the board mapped under her pillow.)*

scenes.chapterTitle: Note to Carrier to Banking House
scenes.synopsis: morning — Henry's letter; the dispatch roads confirmed; the Horse Guards whisper, on his record. (Turns: 8)
scenes.prose:
> The morning post brought Henry's letter — the one she had been expecting since the masquerade, and dreading a little.
> *(The letter: the familiar hand, the soldier's brevity, the news from London.)*
> "The dispatch roads you asked after," he wrote. "Confirmed — the routes, the schedules, the posting-houses; the system is as you mapped it. Your Network moves money the way the army moves orders. I have put it in writing for Quill."
> And then, below, in a different ink — added later, she thought: "There is a whisper at the Horse Guards. An inquiry — informal, so far — into certain officers' private correspondence. My name has been mentioned. I tell you because you would want to know, and because I would rather you heard it from me."
> (T1 · look closer) *She studies the dispatch confirmation — the routes, the schedules; Henry's knowledge, in writing; the chain's London end, corroborated.* — remembered: *the corroboration.*
> (T2 · look closer) *She studies the second ink — the whisper; informal, so far; his name, mentioned; the soldier's honesty, costing him.* — remembered: *the cost.*
> (T3 · stance) *She decides what the whisper means — the Network, or its friends, pushing back; the inquiry is the war's counter-move.* — remembered: *the counter-move.*
> (T4 · choice — the letter's answer:)*
> - **Write at once** — *Loyalty+.* The reply, immediate; Henry, answered before the ink is dry.
> - **Think first** — *Prudence+.* The reply, weighed; the soldier deserves consideration, not haste.
> (T5 · look closer) *She examines her own stake — Henry, the honorable suitor; the inquiry threatens him because of her war; the guilt, and the resolve.* — remembered: *the stake.*
> (T6 · stance) *She decides she will not abandon him — whatever the inquiry, whatever the cost; the war does not sacrifice its honorable.* — remembered: *the resolve.*
> (T7 · social maneuver) *She drafts Quill's copy — the dispatch roads, in writing; the solicitor's brief, strengthened.* — remembered: *the brief.*
> (T8 · remembered micro-decision) *She files the letter with the campaign book — the corroboration, evidenced; Henry's honesty, kept.* — remembered: *the keeping.*
> *(The letter is filed. The reply is drafted. And Rose Hartwell — who has spent the season learning what loyalty costs — begins to learn what it costs when the bill comes due.)*

scenes.chapterTitle: Note to Carrier to Banking House
scenes.synopsis: the aunt's counsel — the Horse Guards whisper; what loyalty requires. (Turns: 8)
scenes.prose:
> "The Horse Guards," Letitia said, reading the letter's second page, "is not a place one wants one's name mentioned. Not even informally. Not even so far."
> "It is a counter-move," Rose said. "The Network pushing back — through friends, through whispers."
> "Or," Letitia said carefully, "it is nothing. Inquiries happen. Officers' correspondence is always of interest. You must not see the Network in every shadow, my love — that way lies the very paranoia that makes heiresses ridiculous."
> (T1 · stance) *Rose weighs the aunt's caution — paranoia, or pattern? The Network has shown its shape; the whisper fits the shape.* — remembered: *the weighing.*
> (T2 · choice — the counsel sought:)*
> - **"Defend him."** — *Loyalty+.* Ask the aunt how — her connections, her judgment; Henry, shielded.
> - **"Let it run."** — *Trust+.* The inquiry is informal; interference would look like guilt; let the soldier's record speak.
> - **"Ask him to withdraw."** — *Protection+.* From the war, from her; Henry safe, if distant.
> (T3 · look closer) *She studies Letitia's face — the aunt is frightened, a little; the war is reaching people Rose loves.* — remembered: *the fright.*
> (T4 · tone) *She chooses how to carry the fright — her own, and her aunt's.*
> - **Steady** — *"We will manage it."* — the general, reassuring the troops.
> - **Honest** — *"I am afraid too."* — the niece, confessing to the aunt.
> (T5 · stance) *She decides the whisper does not change the war — Henry's danger is a reason to win faster, not to stop.* — remembered: *the faster.*
> (T6 · social maneuver) *She asks Letitia to write — to her own connections, discreet inquiries; the aunt's network, mobilized.* — remembered: *the mobilization.*
> (T7 · remembered micro-decision) *She copies the whisper's wording into the book — "informal, so far"; the counter-move, evidenced.* — remembered: *the wording.*
> (T8 · choice — the letter's sending:)*
> - **Today** — *Swift+.* The reply to Henry, by today's post; the soldier, answered.
> - **With Quill's** — *Joined+.* The reply with the solicitor's brief; loyalty and law, in one post.
> *(She sends it today — swift, honest, unadorned. And Letitia, watching her seal it, says quietly, "You love him." It is not a question. Rose does not answer it — which, the aunt understands, is answer enough.)*

scenes.chapterTitle: Note to Carrier to Banking House
scenes.synopsis: ★ KEY DECISION 2/3 — HENRY. Defend him at Horse Guards, let the inquiry run, or ask him to withdraw. (Turns: 3 — the decision itself)
scenes.prose:
> The letter lay sealed on the desk — the reply, written — and behind it, the real decision waited: the one about Henry himself.
> The Horse Guards whisper was informal, so far. It could be met — defended, with connections and character and the full weight of the Hartwell name behind an honorable officer. It could be left to run — trusted to the soldier's clean record, unhelped, unhurried. Or Henry could be asked to withdraw — from the war, from her, from the danger her fight had brought to his door.
> Three fates for an honorable man. And Rose, who had spent the season deciding everyone else's fate, found this one the hardest of all.
*★ KEY DECISION 2/3 — Henry and the Horse Guards:*
- **Defend him** — *Loyalty+, the soldier shielded.* Connections mobilized, character vouched, the Hartwell name behind him; the inquiry met head-on.
- **Let the inquiry run** — *Trust+, the record trusted.* No interference, no appearance of guilt; the honorable officer's record speaks for itself.
- **Ask him to withdraw** — *Protection+, the soldier spared.* From the war, from her; Henry safe — if distant, if diminished.
> *(The game remembers the choice — and the means: the tone of the defending, the patience of the trusting, the pain of the asking. Henry's fate is the chapter's second seal.)*

scenes.chapterTitle: Note to Carrier to Banking House
scenes.synopsis: the decision's sending — the letter goes; Henry's fate, set in motion. (Turns: 7)
scenes.prose:
> The decision made, the letter went — by the morning post, sealed, unadorned; whatever she had chosen, it was chosen cleanly.
> *(The post; the letter; the waiting that follows all dispatches.)*
> (T1 · choice — the sending:)*
> - **The defense mobilized** — *If defend: Letitia's letters, the connections; the shield, raised.* — remembered: *the shield.*
> - **The trust declared** — *If let run: the letter says "I trust your record"; the soldier, unhelped and honored.* — remembered: *the honor.*
> - **The asking written** — *If withdraw: the hardest paragraph she has ever written; the protection, offered.* — remembered: *the offering.*
> (T2 · stance) *She decides the waiting is the war's tax — dispatches sent, answers pending; the general learns patience or breaks.* — remembered: *the tax.*
> (T3 · look closer) *She examines her own heart — the season's slow education; the honorable suitor, the friend, the soldier; whatever he is, he is hers to protect.* — remembered: *the heart, examined.*
> (T4 · social maneuver) *She writes Quill — the dispatch roads, the inquiry; the solicitor needs the whole field.* — remembered: *the field, shared.*
> (T5 · remembered micro-decision) *She notes the decision in the book — Henry's fate, in her hand; the war's cost, itemized.* — remembered: *the itemizing.*
> (T6 · stance) *She decides the cost is bearable — because the alternative, abandoning him, is not.* — remembered: *the bearing.*
> (T7 · choice — the day's turn:)*
> - **The Pump Room** — *Composure+.* Be seen, calm; the town reads nothing, which is the point.
> - **The book** — *War+.* The chain's map, refined; the waiting, spent usefully.
> The letter went into the morning post with the others — bills, invitations, the ordinary mail of an ordinary household — and Rose stood at the window afterward, watching the postman turn the corner. Dispatch sent. The waiting would be the war's tax, and she would pay it. But the letter was clean — whatever she had chosen for Henry, it was chosen without flinching, and the unflinching was the point. Letitia, coming in with the chocolate, took one look at her face and said nothing at all, which was exactly right.
> *(She chooses the book. The waiting is spent usefully — the chain's map refined, the evidence ordered — and Rose Hartwell, who has set an honorable man's fate in motion, works while she waits, the way generals do.)*

scenes.chapterTitle: Note to Carrier to Banking House
scenes.synopsis: the assembly's echo — Bath the morning after; what the town saw. (Turns: 7)
scenes.prose:
> Bath the morning after was a town digesting — the assembly's brilliance, the supper's talk, the particular brilliance of Miss Hartwell, attentive, in sapphire (or crape, or emerald).
> *(The Pump Room: the talk, the glances, the revised estimates being revised again.)*
> "You were magnificent," Letitia reported, over chocolate. "Mrs. Drummond said so. Mrs. Allen said so. The assembly-master's sister said so three times, which means the whole town will have it by dinner."
> "And the banking men?" Rose asked.
> "The banking men," Letitia said, "said nothing. Which, in banking men, is practically applause."
> (T1 · look closer) *She reads the town's digestion — the compliments, the repetition; Bath has decided the evening meant something, and is deciding what.* — remembered: *the digestion.*
> (T2 · stance) *She decides the town's reading is useful — magnificent is a cover; the survey hides inside the social triumph.* — remembered: *the cover.*
> (T3 · social maneuver) *She makes the Pump Room round — gracious, composed; the triumph, worn lightly.* — remembered: *the lightness.*
> (T4 · look closer) *She notes the banking men's absence — not at the waters; the money, digesting separately.* — remembered: *the separation.*
> (T5 · stance) *She decides the separation means the evening registered — the chain felt something, even if it cannot name it.* — remembered: *the registering.*
> (T6 · remembered micro-decision) *She buys the Gazette — Bell's verdict, awaited; the paper will have its say.* — remembered: *the awaiting.*
> (T7 · choice — the morning's use:)*
> - **Be seen** — *Triumph+.* The crescent, the shops; let Bath enjoy its heroine.
> - **Withdraw** — *War+.* The lodgings, the book; the survey's fruits, processed.
> The Pump Room was full of it — the assembly dissected over the waters, the way Bath dissects everything: who danced with whom, who wore what, and Miss Hartwell, attentive, in sapphire, watching the room the way the room watched her. "Magnificent," Mrs. Allen was saying, to anyone who would listen, and several who would not. Rose took her glass and smiled and let the town have its triumph. The survey hid inside the social victory like a dispatch inside a love letter.
> *(She withdraws — graciously, visibly, then gone. The town keeps its heroine; the general keeps her morning.)*

scenes.chapterTitle: Note to Carrier to Banking House

scenes.prose:
> *(The morning Gazette, read over chocolate. Mrs. Nance Bell, proprietor, in her own voice:)*
> *"Miss Hartwell attends. The Bath assembly finds her — attentive."*
> (T1 · stance) *Rose reads it twice — Bell's dry precision; "attentive" is the brief's word, given back to her by the paper; the Gazette has read the evening exactly, and said so in one word.* — remembered: *the word, returned.*
scenes.sting: Miss Hartwell attends. The Bath assembly finds her — attentive.

scenes.chapterTitle: Note to Carrier to Banking House
scenes.synopsis: the sting's savoring — what "attentive" buys; Bell as ally, unknowing. (Turns: 7)
scenes.prose:
> "Attentive." Rose turned the word over like a coin. Bell had read the evening — the watching, the survey, the whole of it — and returned the brief's own word, in print, for the town to chew on.
> *(The lodgings; the Gazette, folded; the word, savored.)*
> (T1 · look closer) *She studies Bell's phrasing — "finds her — attentive"; the dash, the pause; the paper's dryness, doing double work.* — remembered: *the dash.*
> (T2 · stance) *She decides the sting is a shield — the town reads "attentive" as social; the Network, if it reads at all, reads a lady noticed.* — remembered: *the shield.*
> (T3 · choice — the paper's use:)*
> - **Clip it** — *Vanity+.* The verdict, kept; the season's notices, collected.
> - **File it** — *War+.* The verdict, evidenced; the campaign book gains Bell's reading.
> - **Send it** — *Message+.* To Henry, to Augusta; the word, shared with the war's own.
> (T4 · look closer) *She considers Bell's knowledge — does the proprietor know what "attentive" meant? The paper judges; whether it understands is its own secret.* — remembered: *the secret.*
> (T5 · stance) *She decides Bell is an ally, unknowing — the Gazette's verdicts have armored every move; the paper is the war's unwitting artillery.* — remembered: *the artillery.*
> (T6 · remembered micro-decision) *She writes Bell a note — thanks, for the notice; the proprietor, cultivated.* — remembered: *the cultivation.*
> (T7 · choice — the day's doctrine:)*
> - **Savor** — *Pleasure+.* The triumph, enjoyed; even generals take chocolate.
> - **Spend** — *War+.* The triumph, converted; "attentive" becomes the next move's cover.
> She read the rest of the Gazette with unusual attention — the births, the marriages, the notices of assemblies to come — seeing, for the first time, the paper as an instrument rather than a mirror. Bell's dryness was everywhere: a rout "thinly attended, and thinner enjoyed"; a marriage "announced with the usual confidence." The proprietor judged everything, kindly or not, and the town took its temperature from her. "Attentive" was Rose's word now, given back to her in print. She folded the paper with care. Instruments should be kept clean.
> *(She spends it. The triumph is converted — "attentive" becomes cover — and Rose Hartwell, whom the Gazette finds attentive, goes back to the book.)*

scenes.chapterTitle: Note to Carrier to Banking House
scenes.synopsis: merge-board texture — the standing order queue; free income, honestly earned. (Turns: 7)
scenes.prose:
> The merge board was waiting — the standing order queue, the free-income engine, the atelier's commissions filling while the war ran.
> *(System: the standing order queue — ten slots, filled and filling; orders complete, coins accrue; the economy's honest engine, turning.)*
> (T1 · remembered micro-decision) *She collects the finished orders — the coins, counted; the purse, fed by play.* — remembered: *the collecting.*
> (T2 · remembered micro-decision) *She sets the new queue — ten slots, prioritized; the atelier's week, planned.* — remembered: *the queuing.*
> (T3 · look closer) *She studies the queue's economics — the coins, the favors, the slow honest accumulation; the iron rule, visible: time earns everything.* — remembered: *the earning.*
> (T4 · stance) *She decides the board is the war's quartermaster — the season's purse, the ritual's pins, the mercy's sum; all of it, funded by play.* — remembered: *the quartermaster.*
> (T5 · choice — the surplus:)*
> - **Save it** — *Prudence+.* The purse, deepened; the war's reserves, against the unknown.
> - **Spend it** — *Investment+.* The atelier, the commissions; the engine, fed to run faster.
> (T6 · remembered micro-decision) *She checks the order book — three commissions, the season's fashion spine; the gowns, the fittings, the triumphs to come.* — remembered: *the spine.*
> (T7 · stance) *She decides the board is also a cover — a woman deep in her atelier's orders is a woman with no time for wars; the town sees the commissions, not the campaign.* — remembered: *the cover.*
> The order book lay open beside the board — three commissions, the season's fashion spine: a riding habit for a colonel's daughter, a ball gown for the assembly's next triumph, a morning dress for a bride. Elise's pencil notes in the margins, the measurements, the fabric swatches pinned like small flags. This was the other war — the honest one, where the victories were hems and the defeats were only muslin. Rose ran her finger down the commissions and felt the particular calm of work that could be finished.
> *(The board is set, the queue is filled, the coins accrue — and Rose Hartwell, quartermaster of her own war, returns to the sharper business.)*

scenes.chapterTitle: Note to Carrier to Banking House
scenes.synopsis: the banker's report — the chain, the morning after; what the money did next. (Turns: 8)
scenes.prose:
> Trelawney came at noon — unannounced, which for Trelawney was practically a scream — with the morning after's report.
> "Sykes has gone quiet," he said, without preamble. "The discounting — paused. Not stopped. Paused. And Voss — " the banker hesitated — "Voss leaves Bath tomorrow. London."
> (T1 · look closer) *She studies the banker's face — frightened, still, but game; the report, delivered like a dispatch.* — remembered: *the dispatch.*
> (T2 · stance) *She decides the pause means the chain felt the survey — not the mapping, but the watching; the money is holding its breath.* — remembered: *the breath, held.*
> (T3 · choice — the questions:)*
> - **"What does Sykes fear?"** — *Weakness+.* The banker's read; Trelawney names it: being seen.
> - **"Where does Voss go?"** — *Pursuit+.* London — but where in London? The direction, tested.
> - **"What do we do?"** — *Counsel+.* The banker's need; Rose gives him the next move.
> (T4 · look closer) *She examines Voss's departure — tomorrow, London; the front's man, recalled, or retreating; either way, the Bath errand ends.* — remembered: *the ending.*
> (T5 · stance) *She decides the quiet is data — the chain goes quiet because they know; the Network has felt the mapping, even unmapped.* — remembered: *the data.*
> (T6 · social maneuver) *She steadies Trelawney — the banker's hand, the reassurance; frightened and game is exactly what's needed.* — remembered: *the steadying.*
> (T7 · remembered micro-decision) *She writes the report into the book — Sykes quiet, Voss departing; the chain's state, evidenced.* — remembered: *the state.*
> (T8 · choice — the banker's orders:)*
> - **Keep watching Sykes** — *Vigilance+.* The pause may break; the banker watches for the resumption.
> - **Let Sykes rest** — *Patience+.* The watching, eased; a rested chain moves sooner.
> The counting-house smelled of ledgers and coal-smoke — Trelawney's kingdom, all brass and paper. He showed her the discount book, the entries in his careful hand: the notes Sykes had brought, the amounts, the dates. "Paused," he said, tapping the last entry. "Not stopped. The difference matters." His hands were steady on the page — the frightened banker of last month would have spilled the ink. Rose watched the steadiness and understood that the war was making him, the way it was making her.
> *(She orders vigilance — kindly, firmly. Trelawney straightens, enlisted, and goes. And Rose stands at the window, watching the street where the money used to move.)*

scenes.chapterTitle: Note to Carrier to Banking House
scenes.synopsis: the carriers, warned or watched — the young man's stillness, reconsidered. (Turns: 7)
scenes.prose:
> That afternoon, on the crescent, she saw the young man — the chain's youngest hand, the still one — and he saw her seeing him.
> *(The crescent: the promenade, the afternoon crowd, the young man stopped mid-step, caught in the act of being unremarkable.)*
> It was the briefest thing — a look, held a heartbeat too long. He knew. Not the mapping, not the name — but the watching. The chain's youngest hand had felt the surveyor's eye, and the eye had not looked away.
> (T1 · look closer) *She studies the heartbeat — the held look; the youngest hand is the chain's most human link, and the most readable.* — remembered: *the readability.*
> (T2 · stance) *She decides not to look away — the gaze, held; let him carry back that Miss Hartwell sees.* — remembered: *the gaze, held.*
> (T3 · choice — the message:)*
> - **A nod** — *Mercy+.* The smallest acknowledgment; the young man, seen and spared.
> - **A stare** — *Warning+.* The full attention; the young man, seen and warned.
> - **Nothing** — *Discipline+.* The look away, the promenade resumed; the surveyor, unreadable.
> (T4 · look closer) *She considers what he carries back — to the thin man, to the clerk, to Voss; the report of being seen, traveling up the chain.* — remembered: *the report.*
> (T5 · stance) *She decides the report is useful — let the chain know it is watched; watched chains make mistakes.* — remembered: *the usefulness.*
> (T6 · remembered micro-decision) *She notes it in the book — the crescent, the hour, the held look; the chain's awareness, evidenced.* — remembered: *the awareness.*
> (T7 · choice — the walk's end:)*
> - **Follow** — *Pursuit+.* At a distance, the promenade's pace; see where the youngest hand goes.
> - **Release** — *Patience+.* Let him go; the chain's hands will move again, and she will be watching.
> The crescent curved away below them, the afternoon crowd at its brightest — children with hoops, ladies with parasols, a fiddler playing for pennies by the railings. The young man had stopped by a print-shop window, studying the caricatures with the particular intensity of someone pretending to study caricatures. Rose kept her pace, her parasol, her composure. The held look traveled between them like a note passed in a ballroom — unsigned, unmistakable. He looked away first.
> *(She releases him — the promenade resumed, the afternoon intact. But the held look travels with her, and with him: the chain knows it is watched, and the watching has a face now.)*

scenes.chapterTitle: Note to Carrier to Banking House
scenes.synopsis: the war's arithmetic — strike, watch, or warn; the options, laid out before the decision. (Turns: 7)
scenes.prose:
> Evening. The campaign book open to the chain's map — and Rose, doing the war's arithmetic.
> *(The map: NOTE — CARRIER — BANKING HOUSE; Sykes quiet, Voss departing, the young man warned; the chain, mapped and half-aware.)*
> Three moves. Strike now — use the mapping, the name, the evidence; move on Sykes, on the paper, on the chain's Bath end, while it is still in reach. Keep watching — the survey extended; let the quiet chain move again, and map the London end when it does. Or warn the carriers off — the held look, made policy; tell the chain's hands, plainly, that they are seen, and watch the chain scatter.
> (T1 · stance) *She weighs the strike — the evidence is real, the mapping complete; but strikes need law, and law needs Quill, and Quill needs months.* — remembered: *the months.*
> (T2 · stance) *She weighs the watching — patience has paid all season; but the chain is going quiet, and quiet chains starve watchers.* — remembered: *the starving.*
> (T3 · stance) *She weighs the warning — scattering the chain feels like victory, but scattered chains re-form; warnings are the one move that cannot be unmade.* — remembered: *the unmaking.*

> The map covered two pages now — the chain's three links drawn in ink, the three runs marked, the nod from Sykes to Voss rendered as a small, damning arrow. Rose looked at the beauty of it and felt the general's particular reluctance: it would be a shame to waste such a map on anything less than victory.

scenes.chapterTitle: Note to Carrier to Banking House
scenes.synopsis: ★ KEY DECISION 3/3 — THE CHAIN. Strike now, keep watching, or warn the carriers off. (Turns: 3 — the decision itself)
scenes.prose:
> "Note to carrier to banking house," Rose said aloud, to the empty room — the chain's whole shape, in seven words. Mapped. Evidenced. Thrice-run. And now, the question the mapping had been building toward all evening: what does the surveyor do with the survey?
> Strike now — move on the chain's Bath end while it is in reach, with the name and the evidence as weapons. Keep watching — extend the survey, let the quiet chain move again, map the London end when it stirs. Or warn the carriers off — make the held look policy, tell the chain's hands they are seen, and scatter what she has so carefully mapped.
*★ KEY DECISION 3/3 — The chain's fate:*
- **Strike now** — *Nerve+, the survey weaponized.* Quill briefed, Sykes approached, the Bath end moved upon; the war goes open, with evidence.
- **Keep watching** — *Patience+, the survey extended.* The quiet chain, given time; the London end mapped when it moves; the general waits.
- **Warn the carriers off** — *Mercy+, the chain scattered.* The hands told they are seen; the Bath circuit broken — and the London end, warned too.
> *(The game remembers the choice — and the means: the tone of the striking, the discipline of the watching, the mercy of the warning. The chain's fate is the chapter's seal.)*

scenes.chapterTitle: Note to Carrier to Banking House

> *(The lodgings' window: the crescent dark, the street silent; the money, paused.)*
> (T1 · look closer) *She studies the quiet — Sykes paused, Voss departing, the young man warned; the chain's Bath end, exhaling.* — remembered: *the exhaling.*
> (T2 · stance) *She decides the quiet is victory's shape — not the war won, but the battle; the mapped chain, disrupted.* — remembered: *the disruption.*
> (T3 · choice — the quiet's meaning:)*

> - **They suspect** — *Cautious+.* Something felt, nothing known; the quiet is prudence.
> - **They wait** — *Patient+.* The chain, coiled; the quiet is preparation.
> (T4 · look closer) *She considers London — the direction, the account, the financier; the war's next ground, waiting.* — remembered: *the waiting.*
> (T5 · stance) *She decides Bath's work is done — the circuit mapped, the face named, the chain disrupted; what remains is London.* — remembered: *the done.*
> (T6 · remembered micro-decision) *She touches the glove — Cecilia's glove, the secret delivered; the chapter's relic, kept.* — remembered: *the relic.*
> (T7 · choice — the night's last thought:)*
> - **The name** — *Lucien de Valcourt.* — the London face, in the dark.
> - **The number** — *No. 9, Greville Street.* — the direction, in the dark.
> - **The chain** — *Note to carrier to banking house.* — the shape, in the dark.
> Bath at night was a different town — the crescent's windows lit like a string of lanterns, the assembly rooms dark, the card room's pens stilled. Somewhere, the carriers' corners stood empty; somewhere, Voss's dispatch case sat packed for the morning coach. The money was holding its breath. Rose stood at the lodgings' window and named the quiet for what it was: the sound of a chain that knows it has been seen. It was not victory. But it was the shape victory would take, when it came.
> *(She chooses all three — the name, the number, the chain; the dark holds them equally. And Rose Hartwell, no longer the person being moved, sleeps with the war's whole shape in her head.)*

> (T2 · stance) *She decides what the news is — the survey, the watching, the name (spoken or held); London will hear of Bath.* — remembered: *the hearing.*

Voss supervised the loading of the dispatch case himself, the leather box handed up like a relic. The clerk hovered, the inevitable second cup of coffee in his hand. Rose watched from the bookseller's window, a volume of poetry held upside down. The front's man was going home to London with the assembly's news. Let him carry it, she thought. Let London hear that Bath is watched.

And yet the town went on being Bath: the waters drunk, the gossip traded, the Pump Room full. The war had left no mark on the surface. That, Rose thought, was the most unsettling thing of all.
> *(The corners stay empty. The town stays bright. And Rose walks home through the afternoon with the particular satisfaction of a surveyor whose map has changed the territory.)*

The solicitor's hand was as careful as his thinking: every sentence weighed, every promise qualified. "The law will keep pace — slowly." It was the most honest sentence any man had written her all season. Rose folded the letter and felt the particular comfort of slow things: the law, the seasons, the building of a case stone by stone. The rooms were hers to win quickly. The courts could take their time.
> *(She chooses the town — the heroine, expected. The law keeps its pace; the rooms keep theirs; and Rose keeps both, the way she keeps everything now: mapped, filed, and moving.)*

> *(Mrs. Allen's drawing room: the tea, the talk, the name dropped by a colonel's wife who had it from a banker who had it from London.)*
> "Drummond — the London man, you know, the obligations — is asking after the Hartwell settlements," the colonel's wife said. "The second installment, particularly. Whether it will be met, and when."
> The room turned to Rose — politely, delicately, the way rooms turn to heiresses when money is mentioned.
> (T1 · look closer) *She studies the room's turning — the delicacy, the politeness; the town, scenting money-talk.* — remembered: *the scenting.*
> (T2 · stance) *She decides what the asking means — the Network's appetite, made audible; Drummond is the London face's question, asked in Bath.* — remembered: *the audible.*
> (T3 · tone) *She chooses her answer — the room is watching.*
> - **Light** — *"The settlements are in hand, thank you."* — the heiress, untroubled.
> - **Direct** — *"Mr. Drummond may ask me himself."* — the surveyor, undisguised.
> - **Amused** — *"Bath knows my business better than I do."* — the lady, deflecting.
> (T4 · look closer) *She examines the second installment — what it is, when it falls, what depends on it; the obligation, inventoried.* — remembered: *the inventoried.*
> (T5 · social maneuver) *She turns the talk — to the assembly, to the music; the money-talk, drowned politely.* — remembered: *the drowning.*
> (T6 · stance) *She decides Drummond's asking is the chain's new shape — the Bath circuit broken, the pressure moved to the settlements.* — remembered: *the moved.*
> (T7 · remembered micro-decision) *She notes it in the book — Drummond, Bath, the second installment asked after.* — remembered: *the noting.*

> - **Go** — *War+.* Augusta must know; the letter, written tonight.

The colonel's wife repeated the banker's words with the particular relish of a woman carrying news: "The second installment, particularly. Whether it will be met, and when." The room's delicacy was exquisite — the pauses, the glances, the way nobody looked directly at Rose while everybody watched her. Bath at its most civilized, which is to say its most ruthless. Rose set down her cup and smiled the smile she had practiced for exactly this moment.
> *(She goes — politely, promptly. The tea keeps its talk; Rose keeps her urgency. And the second installment — the obligation, the question — follows her home like a creditor.)*

scenes.chapterTitle: Note to Carrier to Banking House

> "What is it about?"
> "Pressure," Letitia said. "The Network cannot buy the Park while the settlements hold. So it presses — asks, rumors, watches. It wants someone to answer hastily."
> (T1 · look closer) *Rose examines the installment — the sum, the date, the arrangements; the estate's soundness, verified.* — remembered: *the verified.*
> (T2 · stance) *She decides the asking is the war's new front — not the chain's hands now, but the settlements; the pressure, financial.* — remembered: *the front.*

> (T4 · look closer) *She studies Letitia's counsel — the aunt's financial sense, sound; the pressure must not produce haste.* — remembered: *the soundness.*

> (T6 · social maneuver) *She writes Augusta — her sister must know Drummond is asking; the family's front, united.* — remembered: *the united.*

> - **Meet it on time** — *Steady+.* The arrangements hold; the pressure, outlasted.

Rose spread them on the morning-room table and went through them line by line, the way she had once gone through fashion plates: with total attention and no hurry. The second installment: the sum, the date, the arrangements — sound, all sound. The estate was not the fragile thing the Network hoped. It was a house with good bones. Drummond could ask as often as he liked.
> *(She chooses steadiness — the arrangements hold, the installment will be met on time. And Letitia, approving, pours the wine of women who have declined to hurry.)*

> (T2 · look closer) *She examines what they know — the watching, not the watcher; the fact, not the file; they know they are seen, not what the seeing found.* — remembered: *the limit.*

> - **A target** — *Risk+.* They know she watches; the watcher becomes the watched.

> (T5 · remembered micro-decision) *She writes the reckoning in the book — "They will know. Let them."* — remembered: *the letting.*

> - **The window** — *Vigil+.* Bath at night; the empty corners, watched anyway.
> (T7 · stance) *She decides the war's next ground is London — the direction, the account; Bath's survey complete, the capital awaits.* — remembered: *the awaiting.*
> The lamp burned low — the oil nearly gone, the flame guttering. Rose turned it up and looked at the book's chain pages one last time: the circuit, the name, the direction, the quiet. The mapping had cost her secrecy — the Network would know, because Voss would carry it, because the young man would carry it, because Drummond was already asking. "They will know. Let them." She wrote it under the date, in the good pen, and felt the particular freedom of a general who has stopped hiding.
> *(The book closes. The lamp burns low. And Rose Hartwell — mapped, knowing, known — sleeps with the reckoning filed.)*

> (T2 · choice — the call's target:)*
> - **The Drummonds' circle** — *Bold+.* The question's source, visited; the asking, answered at its door.
> - **The assembly's rooms** — *Public+.* The town's stage; the answer, witnessed by Bath.
> - **The banking street** — *Pointed+.* Sykes's door, Parry's; the money's houses, called upon.
> (T3 · look closer) *She examines what the call must say — unafraid, unhurried, unmoved; the settlements hold, the heiress holds, the Park holds.* — remembered: *the saying.*
> (T4 · social maneuver) *She plans the call's choreography — the hour, the dress, the witnesses; conduct, staged like everything else.* — remembered: *the staging.*
> (T5 · stance) *She decides the call is also the chapter's answer to the mapping's cost — they know she watches; let them watch her unafraid.* — remembered: *the unafraid.*
> (T6 · remembered micro-decision) *She chooses the day — tomorrow; the answer, not rushed; the Network feeds on hurry, and she will not feed it.* — remembered: *the unhurried.*
> (T7 · choice — the preparation:)*
> - **Alone** — *Nerve+.* The call, made solo; the answer, hers entirely.
> - **With Letitia** — *Family+.* The aunt's presence; the family's front, united.
> (T8 · stance) *She decides the call begins the next chapter — the Thorn's answer, through conduct; the war's new instrument.* — remembered: *the instrument.*
> She planned the route the way she planned everything now — the streets, the hour, the witnesses. The call would go to the Drummonds' circle at mid-morning, when Bath was out and the drawing rooms were full. The dress would be the ritual's choice — primrose, pearl-grey, or scarlet — the brief's word made cloth: unafraid. No flowers sent back; the warning would get behavior, not bouquets. Letitia, hearing the plan, said only, "Well. They asked." It was the perfect summary.
> *(The plan is made. The call is set. And Rose Hartwell — who has spent the chapter watching — prepares to be watched, on her own terms.)*

> The book's chain pages, reviewed whole — the assembly's brilliance, the circuit thrice-run, the name in ink, the direction's house number, the quiet's held breath, Drummond's asking. The chapter had an arc, she saw now: from a direction under a pillow to a call planned for tomorrow, from watching to answering. The survey was complete. The answer was prepared. > Morning. The coach, the post, the held breath — Augusta's letters come on the morning coach, and Rose was at the window before the horses.
> *(The street: the coach, the mail-bag, the lodgings' door; the morning, bright with waiting.)*
> (T1 · look closer) *She watches the postman — the bag, the letters; the morning's dispatches, sorted.* — remembered: *the sorting.*
> (T2 · stance) *She decides the waiting is the war's tax — paid again, gladly; some taxes buy good news.* — remembered: *the tax.*
> (T3 · choice — the waiting's use:)*
> - **The window** — *Eager+.* Watching, openly; the household amused.
> - **The breakfast** — *Composed+.* Chocolate, the Gazette; the waiting, dignified.
> - **The book** — *Useful+.* The chain's map, reviewed; the waiting, spent.
> (T4 · social maneuver) *She receives the household's teasing — Letitia, the maid; the heiress at the window, a figure of fun.* — remembered: *the teasing.*
> (T5 · look closer) *She studies the postman's approach — the door, the knock; the letter, or no letter; the morning's verdict.* — remembered: *the verdict.*
> (T6 · stance) *She steadies herself — whatever Augusta writes, it will be met; the sister's news is family news, and family is met standing.* — remembered: *the standing.*
> (T7 · remembered micro-decision) *She takes the letter — Augusta's hand, the seal; the morning's verdict, in her hand.* — remembered: *the taking.*
> The street woke slowly — the sweepers, the milk cart, the first shutters going up. Rose watched it all from the window with the particular intensity of the expectant: every hoofbeat a possible coach, every figure a possible postman. Letitia teased her over chocolate — "You are worse than a girl waiting for a ball invitation" — and Rose, who was in fact waiting for something considerably more consequential than a ball invitation, permitted the teasing. The household laughed. The waiting went on.
> *(The knock. The letter. Augusta's hand. And Rose Hartwell — who has mapped a chain, named a financier, and disrupted a circuit — opens her sister's letter with the particular dread of someone who knows that family news is the news that matters.)*

scenes.chapterTitle: Note to Carrier to Banking House
scenes.synopsis: the chapter's seal — Augusta's letter; Drummond asks after the second installment; Augusta answered "later"; the Network will know Rose mapped it. (Turns: 7)
scenes.prose:
> Augusta's letter was short — the sister's brevity, which meant the news was serious.
> *(The letter, in Augusta's hand:)*
> "Drummond has written — twice. He asks after the second installment: whether it will be met, and when. I have answered him 'later' — the settlements are sound, and I will not be hurried. But Rose — he does not ask like a creditor. He asks like a man taking inventory. And men take inventory before they buy."
> (T1 · look closer) *She studies the "later" — Augusta's non-answer; the sister's courtesy, the family's unhurried; the question, declined.* — remembered: *the declining.*
> (T2 · stance) *She decides the "later" is right — the settlements hold; hurry is the enemy; Augusta has declined to feed the Network.* — remembered: *the right.*
> (T3 · look closer) *She examines "taking inventory" — Augusta's phrase; the Network counts the Park's obligations before it moves.* — remembered: *the counting.*
> (T4 · stance) *She decides the inventory means the mapping registered — Drummond asks because the chain was watched; the Network adjusts, and the adjustment is aimed at the settlements.* — remembered: *the aimed.*
> (T5 · choice — the letter's answer:)*
> - **"Well done."** — *Approval+.* Augusta's "later," commended; the sisters, united.
> - **"Tell me all."** — *Intelligence+.* Every asking, every wording; the inventory, mapped.
> - **"Prepare."** — *War+.* The settlements, the arrangements; the family, readied.
> (T6 · remembered micro-decision) *She writes the letter into the book — Augusta's "later," Drummond's asking; the chapter's last evidence.* — remembered: *the last.*
> (T7 · stance) *She stands at the window — the letter in her hand, Bath bright outside; and she understands, with the particular clarity of the surveyor, that the Network will know she mapped it — because Drummond is asking, and Drummond only asks when London has been told.*
> *(The letter is filed. The chapter seals. And Rose Hartwell — who began the week with a direction under her pillow — ends it with her sister's "later" in her hand, and the certain knowledge that the Network knows: the chain was watched, the face was named, and the Thorn is done being moved.)*
